note: Recommended builds and teams, per Resonator. This is the one file on the desk that is judgement rather than record: which sonata set to farm, which echo to put in the main slot, what to roll for, which weapons rank where, and which teams to build — all of it somebody's opinion, none of it a fact the game publishes. It is credited to prydwen.gg wherever it is shown and `reviewed` is the game version their write-up was last revised against. `sets[].echoes` is the main slot, the echo whose skill you actually cast. `stats.format` is the cost layout of the five slots and `stats.slots` is the main stat wanted in each. `stats.targets` is what each stat should read on the level-90 stat screen — the thresholds that turn the substat priority from an order into something you can act on, since an order alone never says when to stop rolling one stat and start on the next. `weapons[].share` is the damage share Prydwen calculates against the best option. A team slot holds every Resonator named as an alternative for that seat.

sets.name: Sierra Gale
sets.note: Offers a 10% unconditional Aero DMG% boost and an additional 30% Aero DMG% after using the intro lasting 15 seconds for a grand total of 40% additional Aero damage for most of your damage window.

echoes.name: Nightmare: Feilian Beringal
echoes.note: Offers an unconditional 12% Aero DMG and Heavy ATK boost when used as the Main Echo, and additionally is a Summon-type echo making it easy to use in any character's rotation, which often makes it the best option for any character using the set.

sets.name: Windward Pilgrimage
sets.note: Only use this set with Ciaccona on the team. Best set for Aero Main DPS characters who can apply Aero Erosion or have an Aero Erosion applier on the team. Grants 10% Aero DMG Bonus and an extra 30% Aero DMG Bonus as well as 10% CRIT Rate for 10s when attacking targets inflicted with Aero Erosion. Offers an extra 10% CRIT Rate over the other Aero sets such as Gusts of Welkin or Sierra Gale, providing extra overall damage so long as Aero Erosion is present on the enemy.

echoes.name: Nightmare: Kelpie
echoes.note: This Echo provides a free decent amount of Aero DMG when casting Outro Skill in all situations, provides 12% Aero DMG Bonus to Aalto and while its Transform Active Skill is not used in Aalto's rotations, it is the best Main Echo he has, albeit by a very small difference when compared to Reminiscence: Fleurdelys (pick what has the best substats!)

sets.name: Moonlit Clouds
sets.note: Offers a 10% unconditional Energy Regen% boost taking some pressure off your gear when aiming at ER breakpoints. Also upon using Outro, grants the next character switching in a 22.5% ATK boost, amplifying any of your main damage dealers burst windows.

echoes.name: Impermanence Heron
echoes.note: Supportive Echo that can be run at the cost of a sizeable chunk of damage for the character who equips, trading personal gain for team benefits. Should always be used and immediately switch cancelled right before performing an Outro, leading to another DPS. When done so will grant the next character switching in 12% increased DMG% which when combined with the 5P Moonlit set which also grants 22.5% ATK% under the same conditions makes for a sizeable boost. While the echo does lower the damage of whoever wears it, it grants a massive chunk of energy on use usually saving 1 or sometimes even 2 Energy Regen sub stats that may otherwise be needed by the wearer allowing for some damage to be recovered.

weapons.name: Woodland Aria
weapons.note: Simple ATK and CRIT Rate stat-stick for Aalto, who does not benefit from this weapon's effects triggered upon applying Aero Erosion.

weapons.name: Static Mist
weapons.note: Best weapon for Hybrid Aalto. Static Mist is a fantastic weapon for Pistol buffers since it provides an ATK% buff to the next character who Intros into the field making it give an extra buff to the Moonlit Clouds Echo set; additionally it provides high Base ATK & CRIT Rate for good personal damage and provides Energy Regen to alleviate Energy costs. Fantastic weapon for buffing characters overall.

weapons.name: Relativistic Jet
weapons.note: This weapon is a good 4-star for characters who need extra Energy thanks to its passive which restores some; however while this is the case for Hybrid Aalto, DPS Aalto tends to not need Energy Regen which causes this weapon's effectiveness to dwindle.

weapons.name: Undying Flame
weapons.note: ATK and Skill DMG stat-stick, pretty simple weapon overall and not too effective for Aalto as a result of its low base stats from being 4-star.

weapons.name: Thunderbolt
weapons.note: Due to this Battle Pass exclusive's low base ATK and Skill DMG-focused effect, its performance isn't as strong as some other available 4-stars but it remains usable.

weapons.name: Solar Flame
weapons.note: This Battle Pass exclusive displays low performance in spite of its CRIT Rate secondary stat and universal ATK% boost because of its lower Base ATK and unusable Heavy ATK DMG-increasing effect; remember having CRIT as a secondary stat doesn't automatically make a weapon good.

weapons.name: Romance in Farewell
weapons.note: For DPS Aalto, calculated assuming the passive can get stacked up — significantly worse otherwise. weapons.name: Novaburst
weapons.note: Alternative 4-star choice that provides extra ATK when dodging. Overall only provides ATK and nothing else making this weapon suboptimal compared to the above choices.

sets.name: Trailblazing Star
sets.note: Aemeath's dedicated Echo Set gives her 20% CRIT Rate and Fusion DMG Bonus easily upkept throughout her rotation. It is her best choice without question due to its very strong stat buffs.

echoes.name: Sigillum
echoes.note: An Echo solely dedicated to Aemeath which gives her 20% Liberation DMG Bonus when equipped in the Main Slot specifically by her. Easily summoned at any point in her rotation during battle.

weapons.note: Aemeath's Signature weapon is obviously her best. It gives her Fusion RES and DEF Ignore on her Liberation damage as well as extra DMG Bonus, CRIT Rate and high Base ATK, which makes it impossible to go wrong with.

weapons.name: Emerald of Genesis
weapons.note: Assumes 1 less Energy Regen roll, distributed into damaging stats instead. weapons.name: Red Spring

weapons.note: Qiuyuan's Signature is mostly an ATK and CRIT Rate stat-stick for Aemeath as she does not deal any Heavy Attack type damage, but it does provide a very marginal increase to Echo damage team-wide.

weapons.name: Blazing Brilliance
weapons.note: ATK and CRIT DMG stat-stick for Aemeath, who does not benefit from this weapon's Skill DMG-focused effects.

weapons.name: Feather Edge
weapons.note: This Battle Pass exclusive is the best 4-star choice for Aemeath as she fully takes advantage of this weapon's ATK and Liberation damage-increasing effects while having a nice CRIT stat to boot. However, its low base ATK makes it pale in comparison to 5-stars.

weapons.name: Somnoire Anchor
weapons.note: An event exclusive that gives some ramp-up ATK and CRIT Rate buffs. A good 4-star choice while not comparable to any 5-star.

weapons.name: Endless Collapse
weapons.note: This 4-star weapon has the main advantage of completely erasing any Energy Regen needs for Aemeath and gives a good amount of ATK, but it doesn't do much else which makes it preferable to upgrade to a 5-star option if possible.

weapons.name: Commando of Conviction
weapons.note: Best No Gacha option for Aemeath, accessible for free at the start of the game. Gives a solid amount of ATK which makes it fine to use for beginners, but try to upgrade to any 5-star as soon as possible.

teams.name: Best Fusion Burst Team
teams.note: With Lupa, have her on Moonlit Clouds alongside Denia on Flaming Clawprint. Lupa Outro buffs Aemeath and Denia rotates first to Outro into Lupa.

teams.name: Best Tune Rupture Team

teams.name: Mono Fusion

Endless Resonance, Reel of Spliced Memories
Moonlit Clouds, Empyrean Anthem, Tidebreaking Courage

echoes.name: The False Sovereign
echoes.note: A Transform and Summon echo similar to Nightmare: Kelpie, which gives 12% Electro and 12% Heavy DMG Bonus passively in the main slot, and unconditionally summons the Echo to deal DMG whenever an Intro skill is triggered, additionally having Transform casts for extra damage. weapons.note: Jiyan's Signature weapon is fantastic on Augusta and has similar performance to even her Signature weapon thanks to its easy to acquire 48% Heavy Attack DMG Bonus increase, as well as 12% general DMG Bonus, good Base ATK and CRIT DMG stats.

weapons.name: Ages of Harvest
weapons.note: While this weapon focuses on boosting Resonance Skill damage, Jinhsi's Signature is still great on Augusta as she does deal some amount of Skill damage and benefits from its good Base ATK, as well as its DMG Bonus and CRIT Rate increasing effects.

weapons.name: Wildfire Mark

weapons.note: Simple ATK and CRIT DMG stat-stick for Augusta, the strongest permanently available choice for her.

weapons.name: Kumokiri
weapons.note: Simple ATK and CRIT Rate stat-stick for Augusta, who does not benefit from this weapon's Liberation DMG-increasing effects.

weapons.name: Lustrous Razor
weapons.note: One of the best permanent choices for Augusta who benefits from its Energy Regen boosting effect but its Resonance Liberation DMG increase is useless on her, which makes it rank below all limited options. weapons.name: Aureate Zenith
weapons.note: The new Battle Pass Broadblade is amazing on Augusta and is her best 4* option bar none as it increases ATK, Heavy Attack DMG Bonus and CRIT DMG by massive amounts especially at Rank 5. Unfortunately, its lower-end Base ATK makes it rank below all 5-star options, but it remains a good choice if you don't wish to invest any pulls into Augusta and rather spend for this weapon instead.

weapons.name: Autumntrace
weapons.note: This Battle Pass weapon also gives Augusta good stats, particularly ATK and CRIT Rate, but suffers like all other 4-star weapons from low Base ATK which causes it to perform lower than all 5-star options. However it remains very much usable on Augusta.

weapons.name: Waning Redshift
weapons.note: The best non-Battle Pass 4-star for Augusta as it gives her some flat Resonance Energy which means she doesn't need any Energy Regen on her build to work, however only increasing ATK isn't enough to make it stand out above other options.

weapons.name: Helios Cleaver
weapons.note: Similar to Waning Redshift but focuses even more on increasing ATK after using multiple Resonance Skills, which Augusta isn't able to fully stack, making it lag behind other choices in terms of performance.

weapons.name: Meditations on Mercy
weapons.note: Last resort option if none of the above weapons are owned. Solely used as an ATK stat-stick as its passive is entirely unused on Augusta, but accessible as a guarantee thanks to being craftable.

weapons.name: Stellar Symphony
weapons.note: Shorekeeper’s signature weapon is not only amazing for her but also for any Rectifier support. Granting insane amounts of Energy Regen as its secondary stat, increasing the equipped character’s HP all the while providing additional Concerto Energy when casting your Ultimate is seriously valuable for any support that can equip the weapon. It additionally provides a team-wide ATK buff if the equipped character’s Resonance Skill is used and it provides healing, which makes it stand out as an amazing support weapon.

weapons.name: Variation
weapons.note: A utility-focused weapon prioritizing lightning-fast Concerto rotations over raw output with the ability to transform entire units' action priorities under the right circumstances. Not always a good choice but when implemented correctly makes all the difference. Also offers an immense amount of Energy Regen further accelerating rotations and supportive capabilities.

weapons.name: Call of the Abyss
weapons.note: Best weapon choice if you don't have Concerto weapons available, acquired for free via Rinascita Exploration Quests, which gives a great amount of Energy Regen and an extra Healing Bonus boost upon casting Ultimate for higher sustain.

weapons.name: Rectifier of Voyager
weapons.note: An easily accessible supportive option with a reasonable amount of Energy Regen. It also grants the unique ability to gain a sizable chunk of raw Resonance Energy once every 20 seconds. For most character's rotations in teams, this bonus will be ready every time it's their turn to switch-in, making this weapon a great choice for any character who doesn't need damage but needs their Ultimate fast and has trouble accessing it otherwise. The flat energy gain is more powerful the less energy the character and team they are a part of can generate. This weapon is preferred over certain 4-star Rectifier options that give Energy Regen such as Rectifier#25 as the flat Energy boost from this weapon's passive is more effective at granting Resonance Energy.

weapons.name: Rectifier#25
weapons.note: Decent F2P craftable option that provides a lot of Energy Regen, some additional HP restore and some ATK% depending on your current HP situation. Little value beyond the Energy Regen and small ATK% boost.

sets.name: Molten Rift
sets.note: Offers a 10% unconditional Fusion DMG% boost and an additional 30% Fusion DMG% after using a Resonance Skill for a grand total of 40% additional Fusion DMG bonus. On Brant, this set is significantly worse damage-wise than Tidebreaking Courage if it is possible to use it, however provided you cannot reach his Energy Regen requirements then this is the best set to use. Make sure to start casting a Skill and cancel it via Brant's Ultimate when his rotation starts to exploit this set's full effect!

echoes.name: Nightmare: Inferno Rider
echoes.note: Offers an unconditional 12% Fusion DMG and 12% Resonance Skill DMG boost when placed in the main slot. While Resonance Skill DMG isn't used at all on Brant, the nature of his kit placing him in the air makes the base Inferno Rider that grants Basic DMG very difficult to use, so an unconditional 12% Fusion DMG Bonus is the next best thing to go for.

sets.name: Tidebreaking Courage
sets.note: Brant's best set provided he can reach its tremendous Energy requirements, due to providing its total of 10% Energy Regen, 15% ATK and 30% DMG Bonus at 250% Energy Regen or above. This requires very good Echoes or his Signature weapon to achieve, and while its activation conditions are very high, the reward in terms of damage increase makes this set worth the investment.

echoes.name: Dragon of Dirge
echoes.note: Offers 12% Basic ATK and 12% Fusion DMG Bonus when equipped in the main slot, making it the best choice for Brant. Its active Transform cast may be difficult to exploit as using it at the end of the rotation will significantly extend Brant's rotation time, so it is best to use it before his main rotation starts if possible.

weapons.name: Unflickering Valor

The massive Energy Regen, Basic ATK DMG and small CRIT Rate boosts the weapon offers are all Brant's top stats, allowing him to sport the Tidebreaking Courage set comfortably, even with a Fusion DMG Bonus Echo if you build his Energy Regen well. However, this sword isn't good on anyone else — only pull it if you have Brant, and if you do pull it, know you'll only use it on him.

weapons.name: Laser Shearer
weapons.note: ATK and Energy Regen stat-stick much like Aero Rover's Signature weapon. Only marginally better than it as it can provide 12% extra ATK via the passive, but generally not worth sparing the pulls when Bloodpact's Pledge is free to obtain.

weapons.name: Bloodpact's Pledge
weapons.note: Aero Rover's Signature weapon is actually very much usable on Brant with Tidebreaking Courage thanks to its high Base ATK and Energy Regen main stat. Unfortunately he is unable to make use of this weapon's passive effects, but as a Base ATK and Energy Regen stat-stick it's his best F2P weapon choice assuming you can acommodate Tideebreaking Courage's steep build requirements.

weapons.name: Red Spring
weapons.note: Camellya's signature weapon is usable by all Basic Attack focused Sword wielding characters, including Brant, but it is designed with her in mind due to a lot of its power locked behind spending Concerto mid-rotation - something only Camellya can do. While Brant is able to make good leverage of most of its stats, but due to being unable to benefit from the Tidebreaking Courage set and not benefitting from the complete passive effect, it ranks lower than the above options.

weapons.name: Emerald of Genesis
weapons.note: The combination of Energy Regen, CRIT Rate and solid Base ATK make this weapon usable on Brant, and while its small ATK% boost is also easy to stack up once, Brant doesn't get to make use of the second stack in his rotations. Unfortunately, unless this weapon is R5 it's not possible to use the Tidebreaking Courage set using it which makes it rank lower than above options.

weapons.name: Stringmaster
weapons.note: The best overall weapon for all Rectifier damage dealers. While Buling is not a damage-oriented character being mostly a Support, she does want to optimize her damage ideally since none of her buffs scale off of a particular stat or condition. As Stringmaster is the best general option for Rectifier damage dealers, it is also the strongest option on Buling thanks to its huge universal damage buffs.

weapons.name: Lethean Elegy
weapons.note: As another strong generalist option, Phrolova's Signature enables Buling to deal a good chunk of damage while not packing as much of a punch as Stringmaster, making it the second best option available for her.

weapons.name: Rime-Draped Sprouts
weapons.note: Mostly an ATK and CRIT DMG stat-stick for Buling, who can barely stack its Basic Attack DMG-oriented effect, but it can still be used decently on her.

weapons.name: Luminous Hymn
weapons.note: Simple ATK and CRIT Rate stat-stick for Buling, who does not benefit from this weapon's Spectro Frazzle-oriented effects.

weapons.name: Cosmic Ripples
weapons.note: Strongest permanently available option, which grants a lot of ATK and increased Energy Regen as well as some minor amounts of Basic Attack DMG to the wearer which Buling uses decently. One of the strongest options to increase Buling's Healing capabilities while simultaneously increasing her damage by a solid amount, this option can be considered even over above options in order to optimize Buling's Sustain capabilities.

weapons.name: Waltz in Masquerade
weapons.note: Fully F2P-accessible craftable weapon that capitalizes on Buling's ability to instantly apply Electro Flare on her enemies, which allows this weapon's ATK-increasing passive to be quickly stacked up to the maximum effect for a lot of ATK buffing in total. Still pales in comparison to any 5-stars due to a lack of solid Base ATK.

sets.name: Void Thunder
sets.note: Offers a 10% unconditional Electro DMG% boost and up to an additional 30% Electro DMG% after you land a combination of 2 Heavy Attacks or Resonance Skills for a grand total of 40% additional Electro damage after fully ramped.

echoes.name: Nightmare: Thundering Mephis
echoes.note: Offers an unconditional 12% Electro DMG and 12% Liberation DMG boost when placed in the main Main Echo slot, making it a solid choice for Electro focused resonators who emphasize Liberation damage and are looking to use the 5P Void Thunder set bonus.

echoes.name: Nightmare: Tempest Mephis
echoes.note: Offers an unconditional 12% Electro DMG and 12% Resonance Skill DMG boost when placed in the Main Echo slot, making it a solid choice for Electro focused resonators who emphasize Resonance Skill damage and are looking to use either the 5P Empyrean Anthem Echo or 5P Void Thunder set bonus.

sets.name: Endless Resonance
sets.note: Offers a 10% unconditional ATK% boost and an additional 5% ATK% for every 1.5 seconds the equipped character has been in combat - up to 20% after 6 seconds, totalling 30% additional ATK% after fully ramped. This set almost almost loses out to most characters signature elemental sets, but is generically usable across all damage characters regardless of their element. The calculations for this set assume you're not swaping during the combo. If you will swap, the set performance drops (to 88.81%).

echoes.name: Mech Abomination
echoes.note: Very easy echo to use that should be used at the very beginning of the burst window right after the Intro. Thanks to its instant cast there is no thinking required and you can enjoy your ATK% boost and some nice burst damage.

As a result, the increase this weapon provides for him definitely exists, it's simply very small.

weapons.name: Lustrous Razor
weapons.note: Top Broadblade option only in competition with some 4★ weapons with multiple copies invested or limited 5★ weapons. Offers high base ATK, ATK%, a good amount of Energy Regen to save at least 1 sub-stat on gear to be reallocated to better uses and a stackable Resonance Liberation ATK DMG% bonus that ramps up as you use Resonance Skills.

weapons.name: Ages of Harvest
weapons.note: A very competitive option to his best in slot if you didn't pull it on the standard banner. The high base ATK, as well as the 24% crit rate and 12% DMG bonus substats are very nice, especially if you need your weapon to even out your crit ratios, in which builds it might outdo Lustrous Razor; and while barely used on Calcharo at all, the Resonance Skill DMG boost is always a small damage increase.

weapons.name: Verdant Summit
weapons.note: Jiyan's signature weapon that's not only fantastic for him but also usable on all damage-focused Broadblade users. Offers a huge main stat of CRIT DMG% granting excellent scaling, 12% permanent generic DMG% and up to 48% increased Heavy ATK DMG% after using 1/2 skills and or a Resonance Liberation.

weapons.name: Autumntrace
weapons.note: Strongest 4★ Broadsword option, granting main stat CRIT RATE for excellent scaling and an incredibly easy to access bonus ability which grants a stacking ATK% buff that only requires you to use Basic or Heavy attacks during your rotation.

weapons.name: Aureate Zenith
weapons.note: Gives solid base stats of ATK and CRIT DMG while also providing increased ATK and Heavy Attack DMG bonus when casting Ultimate. Particularly strong on Broadblade damage dealers who benefit from this attack type, but generally usable in any case.

weapons.name: Waning Redshift
weapons.note: A solid F2P 4* broadblade option for any DPS character scaling off of ATK. The ATK% boost it provides when casting your Resonance Skill is great on most characters, and while the small energy generation it provides at the same time is more situational, it can be handy as well.

weapons.name: Helios Cleaver
weapons.note: A generic option, granting a stacking ATK% buff after using your Resonance Skill that starts at 0 and grants 1 stack every 2 seconds up to 4 stacks - reaching a maximum after 8 seconds. Buff resets shortly after the stack cap limit is reached after which you'll have to repeat the cycle anew. Falls behind other options due to it's buff being inconsistent but still a viable option if you don't have better.

weapons.name: Broadblade#41
weapons.note: Another generic Broadblade option with a mix of utility and offense, granting a large amount of Energy Regen as a main stat. Also a reasonably strong and easy to maintain bonus ability that offers an ATK% buff as long as you remain above 80% HP. Our calculations assume you'll stay above 80% for the whole fight, if you can't you can lower this weapons performance.

teams.name: Best Team
teams.note: Mornye is only best with Lynae on the team.

teams.name: Budget Team
teams.note: This team is entirely incompatible with Swap Cancels.

sets.name: Havoc Eclipse
sets.note: Offers a 10% unconditional Havoc DMG% boost and up to an additional 30% Havoc DMG% after you land 4 Basic or Heavy Attacks for a grand total of 40% additional Havoc damage after fully ramped.

echoes.name: Nightmare: Crownless
echoes.note: Offers an unconditional 12% Havoc DMG and 12% Basic Attack DMG boost when placed in the Main Echo slot, making it a solid choice for Havoc focused resonators who emphasize Basic Attack damage and are looking to use the 5P Sunk-Sinking Eclipse set bonus.

sets.name: Endless Resonance
sets.note: Offers a 10% unconditional ATK% boost and an additional 5% ATK% for every 1.5 seconds the equipped character has been in combat - up to 20% after 6 seconds, totalling 30% additional ATK% after fully ramped. This set almost almost loses out to most characters signature elemental sets, but is generically usable across all damage characters regardless of their element.

echoes.name: Mech Abomination
echoes.note: Very easy echo to use that should be used at the very beginning of the burst window right after the Intro. Thanks to its instant cast there is no thinking required and you can enjoy your ATK% boost and some nice burst damage.

stats.substats: Energy Regen (Until Satisfied) > CRIT Rate = CRIT DMG > ATK% > Basic DMG% > ATK
stats.note: Without Signature, a Havoc DMG 3-cost is always preferred.

targets.note: Lower end estimated in a Lynae+Shorekeeper team, Higher end estimated in a Roccia+Shorekeeper team.

weapons.name: Red Spring
weapons.note: Camellya's Signature is strong on a lot of Sword users, but is in particular designed for her since a lot of extra Basic Attack DMG Bonus is only exploitable if Camellya's Concerto is spent mid-rotation, which is a mechanic only she has access to, making it the best for her by a lot.

weapons.name: Emerald Sentence
weapons.note: Qiuyuan's Signature is a surprisingly good alternative to Camellya's since it sports the same base stats and places a particular emphasis on Echo Skill DMG, which Camellya does a lot more of than most other characters. Also buffs the whole party's Echo Skill DMG, but generally that is negligible.

weapons.name: Frostburn
weapons.note: Simple ATK and CRIT Rate stat-stick for Camellya, who does not benefit from this weapon's Glacio Chafe-related effects.

weapons.name: Everbright Polestar
weapons.note: Simple DMG Bonus and CRIT Rate stat-stick for Camellya, who does not benefit from this weapon's Tune Rupture/Fusion Burst-related effects.

weapons.name: Emerald of Genesis
weapons.note: Best permanent option for Camellya, providing her with CRIT Rate, Energy Regen and some ATK% boosts when casting Skill. Since Camellya only needs a tiny bit of Energy Regen (attributed by default at random in our calculations), this does not come into play and overall is a tiny bit weaker value-wise than above options but still an excellent alternative to her Signature overall.

weapons.name: Blazing Brilliance
weapons.note: Simple ATK and CRIT DMG stat-stick for Camellya, who does not benefit from this weapon's Skill DMG-related effects.

weapons.name: Feather Edge
weapons.note: Provides extra ATK and Liberation DMG Bonus when casting Ultimate as well as some CRIT Rate and low Base ATK. This Battle Pass exclusive is the best 4-star choice Camellya has overall, but Emerald of Genesis is a much more recommended pick-up.

weapons.name: Lumingloss
weapons.note: This Battle Pass exclusive provides solid Base ATK and extra Basic DMG when casting Skill, overall a solid choice but still a 4-star in terms of base stats and lacks CRIT.

weapons.name: Somnoire Anchor
weapons.note: Past event exclusive intended for Camellya, gives her some scaling ATK and CRIT Rate with decent Base ATK. Usable, but overall Emerald of Genesis is still by far the msot recommended.

weapons.name: Commando of Conviction
weapons.note: Best no-gacha option for Camellya, obtainable for free at the start of the game. Just a 4-star ATK stat-stick that gives nothing else, but decent for a start. Pick up Emerald of Genesis or Camellya's Signature ASAP to replace this though.

teams.name: Best Team
teams.note: Mornye is only best with Lynae on the team.

sets.name: Midnight Veil
sets.note: Best set for Cantarella in all Havoc teams. Offers a 10% unconditional Havoc DMG% boost alongside adding a large Havoc Damage hit to the Outro of the wearer. Also grants the incoming resonator a Havoc DMG% boost when the wearer uses their Outro.

echoes.name: Lorelei
echoes.note: Cantarella's best Echo that gives her 12% Havoc and 12% Basic Attack DMG in the main slot. Considering this is a Transform Echo, it has to be used before her rotation ends and must be Swap Cancelled to minimize her rotation time.

sets.name: Moonlit Clouds
sets.note: Best set for Cantarella in all non-Havoc teams. This set sacrifices Cantarella's personal damage in order to provide higher buffing to a single character. It provides an extra 10% Energy Regen to the wielder unconditionally and gives 22.5% ATK to the incoming character for 15s after casting Outro skill, making it one of the strongest sets to buff any ATK-scaling DPS.

echoes.name: Impermanence Heron
echoes.note: The best and only real option 5P Moonlit Clouds has, as it grants an extra 12% DMG Bonus on top of the ATK boost to the next character that Moonlit Clouds would usually give. Additionally restores a lot of Energy to the caster when it deals damage. On Cantarella, this Echo should either be used before her rotation starts or it can be instantly interrupted via her Ultimate - this way, no Energy or damage is generated but the buff will still apply to the incoming ally.

stats.substats: Energy Regen (Until Satisfied) > CRIT RATE = CRIT DMG > ATK% > ATK = Basic ATK DMG%

targets.note: Lower end was estimated with Midnight Veil in a team with Phrolova+Roccia, higher end was estimated with Moonlit Clouds in a team with Carlotta+Shorekeeper.

weapons.name: Whispers of Sirens
weapons.note: Cantarella's signature weapon is expectedly perfect for her, as it gives her a huge boost to many stats including CRIT DMG, ATK, Basic ATK DMG Bonus and can even ignore Havoc RES. These buffs activate naturally quickly in her rotation, making the weapon especially powerful.

weapons.name: Rime-Draped Sprouts
weapons.note: Cantarella can make great use of the passive effects of Zhezhi's signature weapon since she heavily benefits from Basic Attack DMG Bonus. It also has CRIT DMG and ATK% - 2 stats Cantarella enjoys as a damage dealer. Having 3 uses of her Resonance Skill, Cantarella is able to exploit this weapon's passive effects well too. This makes this option an outstanding choice for her if you own it.

weapons.name: Stringmaster
weapons.note: Yinlin's signature weapon is a versatile option that gives a lot great stats such as CRIT Rate, All-Type DMG Bonus and ATK, especially if the character deals off-field damage or uses Swap Cancels. Because of this, it almost always lands as the #1 or #2 weapon of choice for rectifier damage dealers. On Cantarella specifically, it's about equal to Zhezhi's Signature since she uses its passive well.

weapons.name: Lethean Elegy
weapons.note: While this weapon theoretically could provide 8% DEF Ignore to Cantarella in teams where she can Swap Cancel it before casting her Intro, in practice in her best teams since Outro buffs will be active on all 3 team members at once this passive rarely sees any use since interrupting an Echo cast's damage for it is not worth it. Hence, it mostly acts as a CRIT Rate and ATK stat-stick for Cantarella.

weapons.name: Luminous Hymn
weapons.note: Simple ATK and CRIT Rate stat-stick for Cantarella, who doesn't benefit from this weapon's Spectro Frazzle-related effects.

weapons.name: Cosmic Ripples
weapons.note: Best permanently available option for most Rectifier damage dealers, particularly useful on Cantarella since it provides Basic Attack DMG and Energy Regen via its passive, which are stats that Cantarella particularly benefits from.

weapons.name: Radiant Dawn
weapons.note: This Battle Pass exclusive sports a very useful CRIT DMG stat as well as an ATK and Basic ATK DMG Bonus boost when casting any Skill via its passive, which Cantarella can greatly benefit from, making this the best 4-star choice. Still outclassed by any 5-stars due to a lower Base ATK.

weapons.name: Augment
weapons.note: This Battle Pass exclusive sports a very useful CRIT Rate stat as well as an ATK boost when casting Ultimate, which makes it very generally usable and a great 4-star choice for Rectifier damage dealers.

weapons.name: Fusion Accretion
weapons.note: The best non-Battle Pass 4-star for Cantarella as it gives her some flat Resonance Energy which means she needs much less Energy Regen on her build to work, however only increasing ATK isn't enough to make it stand out above other options.

weapons.name: Jinzhou Keeper
weapons.note: Best fully F2P-accessible option, selectable for free at the start of the game or obtained through gacha. Gives a lot of ATK% via its stats and its passive activated upon Intro, but doesn't provide anything else, not making it stand out over the above options.

teams.name: Team #3: Skill Damage Teams
teams.note: Cantarella wielding Moonlit Clouds is significantly stronger than other options to alleviate Energy requirements. Expect the paired DPS character to need higher Energy Regen than usual to function.

sets.name: Frosty Resolve
sets.note: Carlotta's best set bar none, that gives her an unconditional 12% Skill DMG Bonus, 22.5% Glacio DMG Bonus and up to an extra 36% Skill DMG Bonus when casting 2 or more Ultimates (a condition that she easily fulfills). Overall gives a total of 70.5% DMG Bonus at maximum which should speak volumes on how good this set is for Carlotta.

echoes.name: Sentry Construct
echoes.note: The best Main Echo choice for the Frosty Resolve set as it grants 12% Glacio DMG and 12% Skill DMG Bonus when equipped in the main slot. Its active skill also deals a chunk of damage while freezing enemies in place for a short amount of time if fully stacked (which only Carlotta can do). The base cast can also be used during optimized Opener rotations to squeeze a small amount of extra damage.

stats.substats: Energy Regen (Until Satisfied) > CRIT Rate = CRIT DMG > ATK% > Resonance Skill DMG > ATK

targets.note: Lower end was estimated in a team with Zhezhi+Shorekeeper, higher end was estimated in a team with Cantarella+Shorekeeper.

weapons.name: The Last Dance
weapons.note: The best Carlotta stat-stick that gives her a simple 12% ATK and 48% Skill DMG via its passive as well as a huge CRIT DMG stat and a good Base ATK. Pretty self-explanatory.

weapons.name: Phasic Homogenizer
weapons.note: An amazing generalist permanently available pistol that can universally improve the wearer's ATK, DMG Bonus and CRIT DMG. Can get close to a lot of character signatures and is overall a must-have for most accounts.

weapons.name: Woodland Aria
weapons.note: Simple ATK and CRIT Rate stat-stick for Carlotta, who does not benefit from this weapon's Aero Erosion-focused effects.

weapons.name: Static Mist
weapons.note: One of the stronger permanently available choices for Carlotta, which gives her a range of useful stats including high Base ATK, CRIT Rate, and Energy Regen. Also gives the next incoming teammate a small ATK boost after her Outro, which is rather inconsequential in her best teams but can be helpful in some of them.

weapons.name: Undying Flame
weapons.note: Carlotta's best 4-star weapon which gtives her a good amount of ATK and Skill DMG when casting Intro. Simple and effective.

weapons.name: Pistols#26
weapons.note: Best fully F2P-accessible option which outclasses all other 4-star Pistol choices and below, but its passive does require Carlotta to never take any damage from the enemy. However, she is one of the easiest characters to do this with thanks to her really high attack range, so overall this weapon synergizes quite well with her and provides her a good ATK boost.

teams.name: Team #1: Best Team
teams.note: Mornye is only best with Lynae on the team.

sets.name: Windward Pilgrimage
sets.note: Best set for Aero Main DPS characters who can apply Aero Erosion or have an Aero Erosion applier on the team. Grants 10% Aero DMG Bonus and an extra 30% Aero DMG Bonus as well as 10% CRIT Rate for 10s when attacking targets inflicted with Aero Erosion. Offers an extra 10% CRIT Rate over the other Aero sets such as Gusts of Welkin or Sierra Gale, providing extra overall damage so long as Aero Erosion is present on the enemy.

echoes.name: Reminiscence: Fleurdelys
echoes.note: A simple Summon Echo that deals a good chunk of damage, but most importantly grants the assigned Resonator 10% unconditional Aero DMG Bonus if equipped in the Main Slot, with an extra 10% Aero DMG Bonus for Cartethyia, making it the best choice for her.

stats.substats: Energy Regen (Until Satisfied) > CRIT Rate = CRIT DMG > HP% > Basic Attack DMG% = Liberation DMG% > HP

weapons.name: Defier's Thorn
weapons.note: Cartethyia's Signature and her best by a large amount, as it provides her with a massive amount of HP% for her to utilize her kit to the fullest potential. On top of this, having an extra passive 8% DEF Ignore and 20% general DMG Amplification to all targets inflicted with Aero Erosion makes this weapon the uncontested best for Cartethyia, as it is the only option which gives her the stats she truly wants.

weapons.name: Red Spring
weapons.note: Camellya's weapon works well for Cartethyia by virtue of providing 24.3% CRIT Rate as its secondary stat, but also providing an extra 30% Basic Attack DMG bonus via the weapon's passive effect which she uses decently well. For this reason, it is the second best option behind her sought-after Signature.

weapons.name: Feather Edge
weapons.note: This Battle Pass exclusive is fantastic on Cartethyia because the usual issue of 4-star weapons being low Base ATK doesn't hinder her at all (since she doesn't scale off of it). Instead, she can enjoy the large amount of Liberation DMG Bonus (one of her two main damage types) and the 20.3% CRIT Rate provided by the weapon, making it a great alternative to her Signature.

weapons.name: Blazing Brilliance
weapons.note: Simple CRIT DMG and Skill DMG stat-stick for Cartethyia, which doesn't compare to above options as Skill DMG is a negligible part of her damage overall.

weapons.name: Emerald Sentence
weapons.note: Simple CRIT Rate stat-stick for Cartethyia, who barely makes any use of the weapon's passive effects (very minor increase to her Echo Skill DMG which is really negligible).

weapons.name: Emerald of Genesis
weapons.note: CRIT Rate and Energy Regen stat-stick for Cartethyia, making it the best permanently available option as she lacks any good alternatives that aren't from the Battle Pass.

weapons.name: Guardian Sword
weapons.note: Last resort option if none of the above are owned, as this is the only Sword in the game that provides HP% other than Cartethyia's Signature.

teams.name: Team #1
teams.note: Chisa is only stronger than Aero Rover with her Signature. Shorekeeper is also mostly usable in the third slot in Whimpering Wastes since Aero Erosion won't have time to ramp up to 6.

teams.name: Team #2: Alternative Teams
teams.note: Remember Aero Rover is the 2nd character in the rotation with Chisa or Shorekeeper on the team, but they open the rotation with Sanhua on the team. Also use Skyfall Severance to convert Havoc Bane into Erosion if you use them with Chisa!

sets.name: Molten Rift
sets.note: Offers a 10% unconditional Fusion DMG% boost and an additional 30% Fusion DMG% after using a Resonance Skill for a grand total of 40% additional Fusion damage.

echoes.name: Nightmare: Inferno Rider
echoes.note: Offers an unconditional 12% Fusion DMG and 12% Resonance Skill DMG boost when placed in the Main Echo slot, making it a solid choice for Fusion focused resonators who emphasize Resonance Skill damage and are looking to use the 5P Molten Rift set bonus.

stats.substats: Energy Regen (Until Satisfied) > CRIT Rate = CRIT DMG > ATK% > ATK > Resonance Skill DMG%

targets.note: Lower end estimated in Mono Fusion team, Higher end estimated in a team with Brant+Shorekeeper.

weapons.name: Blazing Brilliance
weapons.note: Changli's Signature is her best by a small amount, granting her high CRIT DMG and scaling Skill DMG Bonus over time. Overall it's quite a negligible upgrade from Emerald of Genesis but a worthwhile pickup if you wish to optimize your team's score nonetheless.

weapons.name: Emerald of Genesis
weapons.note: Strongest permanently available option, giving high Base ATK, CRIT Rate and Energy Regen as well as ATK% when casting Skill. Changli uses all of these effects fully and this weapon is hence an outstanding choice for her, making her not Signature weapon-reliant in the slightest.

weapons.name: Emerald Sentence
weapons.note: Qiuyuan's Signature gives the same stats as Emerald of Genesis without the Energy Regen and instead gives a bit of extra Echo Skill DMG Bonus to the whole team. Overall better than Emerald of Genesis if the Energy Regen isn't needed, but not by much.

weapons.name: Frostburn
weapons.note: Simple ATK and CRIT Rate stat-stick for Changli, who does not benefit from this weapon's Glacio Chafe-related effects.

weapons.name: Red Spring
weapons.note: Simple ATK and CRIT Rate stat-stick for Changli, who does not benefit from this weapon's Basic DMG-oriented effects.

weapons.name: Everbright Polestar
weapons.note: Simple DMG Bonus and CRIT Rate stat-stick for Changli, who does not benefit from this weapon's Tune Rupture/Fusion Burst-related effects.

weapons.name: Somnoire Anchor
weapons.note: Best 4-star option for Changli, old event weapon that gives a scaling ATK and small CRIT Rate buff. Mostly an ATK stat-stick but works decently until better options become available.

weapons.name: Commando of Conviction
weapons.note: Best no gacha option for most Sword characters. Just an ATK stat-stick with nothing special to it, decent as a starter weapon. Replace as soon as 5-star choices become available.

teams.name: Best Team
teams.note: Changli buffs Aemeath via her Outro in this team, while Lupa buffs Changli. Only ideally used in Quickswap if Aemeath doesn't have better teammates available. In most cases, use Brant.

teams.name: Expert Team
teams.note: VERY difficult teams to play, won't net good results for most. Pick your second teammate based on preference in strengths/playstyle. Verina is always stronger with Jinhsi.

teams.name: Dual Fusion Team
teams.note: Encore is stronger than Chixia, but more difficult to play.

teams.name: Budget Dual DPS Team
teams.note: This is a budget team so don't expect the best performance here — however it'll still work well.

sets.name: Rejuvenating Glow
sets.note: Best overall set for Chisa with the exception of non-ATK scaling teams like the Cartethyia team. Provides 15% ATK to the whole team practically permanently as long as Chisa triggers healing (very easy to achieve via her Ultimate). The usual Main Echo of this set, Fallacy of No Return, further contributes with Energy Regen to the wielder of the set and an increased ATK boost to all party members on cast. Overall the best set to partially buff Chisa's own damage but most importantly increase her teammates', so long as they scale on ATK.

echoes.name: Fallacy of No Return
echoes.note: Simple summon Echo that can be cast any time (ideally right before the wielder's Outro), granting 10% ATK to the team for 20s (sufficient for 2 other teammates' rotation times if cast right before Outro) as well as 10% Energy Regen to the wielder to help with Energy requirements.

sets.name: Thread of Severed Fate
mix: Havoc Eclipse, Midnight Veil
Endless Resonance, Reel of Spliced Memories
Moonlit Clouds, Empyrean Anthem, Tidebreaking Courage
sets.note: Chisa's best set to maximize her personal damage, which grants her 20% ATK and 30% Liberation DMG Bonus for 5s when applying Havoc Bane. Considering she applies Havoc Bane every 2s all the time and primarily deals Liberation DMG, this set is meant for her.

echoes.name: Reminiscence: Threnodian - Leviathan
echoes.note: Increases Havoc DMG and Liberation DMG Bonus by 12% each in the main slot (Chisa's 2 damage types) while also dealing a good amount of cast damage over 4s after casting which is increased if the target has Havoc Bane applied onto them. Ideally animation cancelled by her Ultimate to not lose on time.

stats.substats: Energy Regen (Until Satisfied) > CRIT Rate = CRIT DMG > ATK% > Liberation DMG% > ATK
stats.note: Havoc DMG is significantly stronger than ATK% on Rejuvenating Glow as a main-stat. On Thread of Severed Fate, they are about equal.

weapons.name: Kumokiri
weapons.note: Chisa's weapon is naturally her best as it plays into her kit, fully stacking and utilizing the 24% Liberation DMG Bonus from the passive and also enabling other Negative Status appliers in the team to gain another 24% DMG Bonus when they apply their own Negative Status. This does not work with Zani but works fine with all other Negative Status characters, including Chisa herself.

weapons.name: Wildfire Mark
weapons.note: Lupa's Signature plays well into Chisa's kit since it grants her high damaging stats and a Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus which allows her to retain good personal damage. However, she does lose out on any team buffing potential with this weapon.

weapons.name: Ages of Harvest
weapons.note: Simple ATK, DMG Bonus and CRIT Rate stat-stick for Chisa who barely benefits from this weapon's Skill DMG-increasing effects.

weapons.name: Verdant Summit
weapons.note: Simple ATK, DMG Bonus and CRIT DMG stat-stick for Chisa who barely benefits from this weapon's Heavy Attack DMG-increasing effects.

weapons.name: Radiance Cleaver
weapons.note: Simple ATK and CRIT DMG stat-stick for Chisa, the strongest permanently available choice for her.

weapons.name: Thunderflare Dominion
weapons.note: Simple ATK and CRIT Rate stat-stick for Chisa who barely benefits from this weapon's Heavy Attack DMG-increasing effects.

weapons.name: Lustrous Razor
weapons.note: One of the best permanently accessible options for Chisa, which grants her with some much appreciated ATK, Energy Regen and Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus on the passive which she can partially utilize, even if she doesn't fully stack its effect up as it requires multiple Skill casts that she doesn't use in practice.

weapons.name: Autumntrace
weapons.note: Only worth using over Meditations on Mercy at R5. This Battle Pass exclusive grants a solid CRIT Rate secondary stat but also provides a lot of ATK when dealing Basic or Heavy Attack DMG which Chisa can stack up twice per rotation (four times in the opener). However, due to its low Base ATK compared to any 5-stars, it remains worse than them.

weapons.name: Meditations on Mercy
weapons.note: The best no-gacha option for Chisa, this Rinascita craftable provides a lot of ATK which is particularly reinforced when dealing damage to enemies with Negative Statuses applied on them, which Chisa can do by herself. A great 4-star choice for her overall by the sheer amount of ATK it provides.

teams.name: Team #1: Best Team
teams.note: Have Chisa on Moonlit Clouds in the 2nd slot with Suisui on the team for optimal buffing, else leave her as a Rejuvenating Glow 3rd slot Support.

teams.name: Team #4: Cartethyia Team
teams.note: Chisa is only stronger than Aero Rover in the third slot with her Signature. Also remember to use Skyfall Severance to convert Havoc Bane into Erosion if you use them with Chisa!

teams.name: Team #5: Phoebe Expert Team
teams.note: Chisa is only worthwhile here with heavy investment and quickswap involved. She is otherwise easily outshined by the likes of Lynae and Phrolova. Generally not recommended to most players. Use Ciaccona in Whimpering Wastes, otherwise stick to Spectro Rover.

sets.name: Molten Rift
sets.note: Offers a 10% unconditional Fusion DMG% boost and an additional 30% Fusion DMG% after using a Resonance Skill for a grand total of 40% additional Fusion damage.

echoes.name: Nightmare: Inferno Rider
echoes.note: Offers an unconditional 12% Fusion DMG and 12% Resonance Skill DMG boost when placed in the Main Echo slot, making it a solid choice for Fusion focused resonators who emphasize Resonance Skill damage and are looking to use the 5P Molten Rift set bonus.

echoes.name: Inferno Rider
echoes.note: Unlike its Nightmare variant, gives a 12% Basic Attack DMG bonus and 12% Fusion DMG bonus, after being transformed into and its last of 3 hits was dealt, for a duration of 15 seconds. This makes this Echo preferable for characters who prefer Basic DMG over Skill DMG, but this option is way more difficult to incorporate in rotations, often requiring Swap Cancelling to be smooth.

stats.substats: Energy Regen (Until Satisfied) > CRIT Rate = CRIT DMG > ATK% > ATK

weapons.name: The Last Dance
weapons.note: Carlotta's Signature and a solid choice for most pistol based resonators due to its decent base damage, very high CRIT DM% and permanent ATK% boost. Far more effective though for resonators that deal some or the majority of their damage through Resonance Skill damaging abilites.

weapons.name: Static Mist
weapons.note: Incredibly potent option offering main stat CRIT RATE, great base damage and a good amount of energy recharge allowing for sub stats to be used elsewhere. Also offers a supportive ability granting the next character to switch in an ATK boost granting it extra value for Hybrid and Support characters.

weapons.name: Thunderbolt
weapons.note: Powerful Gun option for Resonance Skill focused damage characters, but with a heavy conditional required for activation. Grants solid base damage and ATK% via main stats. Also offers an incredibly potent stackable Resonance Skill DMG% bonus that requires the users consistently use Basic Attacks to maintain.

weapons.name: Relativistic Jet
weapons.note: Good generalist 4-star weapon that provides extra Energy and has good Base ATK for a 4-star. Removes any Energy requirements on Chixia.

weapons.name: Novaburst
weapons.note: Gun usable by all resonators, offering good bonuses to ATK but reliant on dodging 3 times initially (with continual dodges after that). Should only be used by those willing to perform dodges at the start of their rotation and consistently after. Calculations assume you perform dodges as soon as possible and maintain the buff.

weapons.name: Undying Flame
weapons.note: Strong gun option for resonators that deal primarily Resonance Skill DMG with little to no conditions to worry about, thanks to its effect being tied to Intro skills. Grants a Resonance Skill DMG bonus that lasts for 15 seconds on using Intro - long enough for most Main DPS to finish their burst window making this a strong consistent option.

weapons.name: Pistols#26
weapons.note: Generic gun option usable by all characters but with a significant ramp-up time on its bonus. Also requires the player not to be hit in order to extract full value. If you do get hit this weapon will fall behind (calculations assume you don't get hit once).

sets.name: Gusts of Welkin
sets.note: Best set for Aero Erosion supports. Allows characters that can apply Aero Erosion to gain a total of 40% Aero DMG Bonus, an equivalent to Sierra Gale. However, it gains an edge over this set by being able to give 15% of that Aero DMG Bonus to the whole team for 20s, providing both offensive and supportive benefits. This set is only favoured on Ciaccona if an Aero Main DPS is present in the team. Use Moonlit Clouds if this doesn't apply.

echoes.name: Nightmare: Kelpie
echoes.note: This Echo provides a free decent amount of Aero DMG when casting Outro Skill in all situations, provides 12% Aero DMG Bonus to Ciaccona and while its Transform Active Skill is not used in Ciaccona's rotations, it is the best Main Echo she has, albeit by a very small difference when compared to Reminiscence: Fleurdelys (pick what has the best substats, or use Fleurdelys if Ciaccona uses Lux & Umbra as her weapon as explained above!)

sets.name: Moonlit Clouds
sets.note: Best set for Ciaccona in all non-Aero teams. This set sacrifices Ciaccona's personal damage in order to provide higher buffing to a single character. It provides an extra 10% Energy Regen to the wielder unconditionally and gives 22.5% ATK to the incoming character for 15s after casting Outro skill, making it one of the strongest sets to buff any ATK-scaling DPS.

echoes.name: Impermanence Heron
echoes.note: The best and only real option 5P Moonlit Clouds has, as it grants an extra 12% DMG Bonus on top of the ATK boost to the next character that Moonlit Clouds would usually give. Additionally restores a lot of Energy to the caster when it deals damage. On Ciaccona, this Echo should either be used before her rotation starts or it can be instantly interrupted at any point via a Dash - this way, no Energy or damage is generated but the buff will still apply to the incoming character.

sets.name: Windward Pilgrimage
sets.note: Used with Main DPS Ciaccona. Best set for Aero Main DPS characters who can apply Aero Erosion or have an Aero Erosion applier on the team. Grants 10% Aero DMG Bonus and an extra 30% Aero DMG Bonus as well as 10% CRIT Rate for 10s when attacking targets inflicted with Aero Erosion. Offers an extra 10% CRIT Rate over the other Aero sets such as Gusts of Welkin or Sierra Gale, providing extra overall damage so long as Aero Erosion is present on the enemy.

echoes.name: Nightmare: Kelpie
echoes.note: This Echo provides a free decent amount of Aero DMG when casting Outro Skill in all situations, provides 12% Aero DMG Bonus to Ciaccona and while its Transform Active Skill is not used in Ciaccona's rotations, it is the best Main Echo she has, albeit by a very small difference when compared to Reminiscence: Fleurdelys (pick what has the best substats!)

stats.substats: Energy Regen (Until Satisfied) > CRIT Rate = CRIT DMG > ATK% > ATK

weapons.name: Woodland Aria
weapons.note: The best option overall for Ciaccona not only from a personal damage perspective but also from a team damage perspective as this weapon shreds the Aero RES of enemies by 10%, which is particularly useful in Aero teams. Still outclasses all other options in any teams thanks to its big personal damage boost.

weapons.name: Phasic Homogenizer
weapons.note: An amazing generalist permanently available pistol that can universally improve the wearer's ATK, DMG Bonus and CRIT DMG. Can get close to a lot of character signatures and is overall a must-have for most accounts. Better than Static Mist in compositions that don't benefit from its ATK buff such as Cartethyia's team.

weapons.name: Lux & Umbra
weapons.note: Best Echo with this weapon is Reminiscence: Fleurdelys. Galbrena's Signature has a good Base ATK and CRIT DMG boosts, but can also amplify Heavy Attack DMG and Echo Skill DMG when both damage types are triggered close to one another alongside an extra DEF Ignore buff. Ciaccona takes a solid damage increase from the Heavy Attack DMG Amplify and DEF Ignore towards the end of her rotation if she uses her Echo Skill while her Forte Heavy Attack is about to cast, making it a great alternative overall.

weapons.name: Spectrum Blaster
weapons.note: Lynae's Signature weapon can proivde extra Basic Attack DMG to Ciaccona and also has a lot of CRIT Rate and ATK for her to benefit from, however she cannot trigger the party-wide buff this weapon provides which makes it generally worse than the permanent banner weapons.

weapons.name: The Last Dance
weapons.note: While Ciaccona takes full advantage of this weapon's passive thanks to her really short rotation, Skill DMG is the most negligible part of her damage types which makes this weapon mostly an atk and CRIT DMG stat-stick. Still a good choice for personal damage overall.

weapons.name: Static Mist
weapons.note: Can outclass Phasic Homogenizer in ATK-scaling teams thanks to team buffing. One of the 2 best permanently available options for Ciaccona, which makes her give 10% ATK to the next character she Outros into and also provides her with high Base ATK, CRIT Rate and some Energy Regen, making her take full advantage of the weapon's passive.

weapons.name: Romance in Farewell
weapons.note: Best 4-star and F2P no-gacha option for Ciaccona, this Rinascita craftable synergizes well with her ability to apply Aero Erosion constantly on enemies, allowing her to take full advantage of this weapon's massive ATK increase. Still lower than other options because it only provides ATK (and 4-stars have lower Base ATK than 5-stars too which makes increasing ATK% less effective).

teams.name: Team #2: Cartethyia Team
teams.note: Chisa is only stronger than Aero Rover with her Signature. Shorekeeper is also mostly usable in the third slot in Whimpering Wastes since Aero Erosion won't have time to ramp up to 6.

teams.name: Team #4: Other Aero Teams
teams.note: Iuno + Lynae + Ciaccona is also one of DPS Iuno's strongest teams by far, exceeding the teams shown here if you have access to it.

teams.name: Team #5: Spectro Frazzle Teams
teams.note: Shorekeeper will only really see use on DPS Phoebe teams in Whimpering Wastes, however it is DPS Phoebe's best Whimpering Wastes team and is worth mentioning.

sets.name: Moonlit Clouds
sets.note: Offers a 10% unconditional Energy Regen% boost taking some pressure off your gear when aiming at ER breakpoints. Also upon using Outro, grants the next character switching in a 22.5% ATK boost, amplifying any of your main damage dealers burst windows.

echoes.name: Impermanence Heron
echoes.note: Supportive Echo that can be run at the cost of a sizeable chunk of damage for the character who equips, trading personal gain for team benefits. Should always be used and immediately switch cancelled right before performing an Outro, leading to another DPS. When done so will grant the next character switching in 12% increased DMG% which when combined with the 5P Moonlit set which also grants 22.5% ATK% under the same conditions makes for a sizeable boost. While the echo does lower the damage of whoever wears it, it grants a massive chunk of energy on use usually saving 1 or sometimes even 2 Energy Regen sub stats that may otherwise be needed by the wearer allowing for some damage to be recovered.

sets.name: Midnight Veil
sets.note: Offers a 10% unconditional Havoc DMG% boost alongside adding a large Havoc Damage hit to the Outro of the wearer. Also grants the incoming resonator a Havoc DMG% boost when the wearer uses their Outro. The set is better than Moonlit Clouds if and only if the equipped character's Echoes have endgame investment (with 9 or 10 CRIT substats total) and the character has a 5-star weapon equipped. If both conditions aren't met, Moonlit Clouds is a better choice.

echoes.name: Lorelei
echoes.note: Offers an unconditional 12% Havoc DMG and 12% Basic DMG boost when placed in the Main Echo slot, making it a solid choice for Havoc focused resonators who emphasize Basic damage and are looking to use the 5P Midnight Veil set bonus.

echoes.name: Nightmare: Impermanence Heron
echoes.note: Offers an unconditional 12% Havoc DMG and 12% Heavy Attack DMG boost when placed in the Main Echo slot, making it a solid choice for Havoc focused resonators who emphasize Heavy Attack damage and are looking to use the 5P Midnight Veil set bonus.

sets.name: Havoc Eclipse
sets.note: Offers a 10% unconditional Havoc DMG% boost and up to an additional 30% Havoc DMG% after you land 4 Basic or Heavy Attacks for a grand total of 40% additional Havoc damage after fully ramped.

echoes.name: Dreamless
echoes.note: One of the strongest burst damage Echoes in the game that also generates a sizeable chunk of Resonance Energy. What makes this Echo strong is that its damage is delivered in a massive 360 degree area around the target it fixates on and is immediately swap cancellable the second it's used with 0 downsides. When using this Echo, always use it and immediately switch out so it deals it's damage and finishes its animation while the caster of the Echo is off the field. Due to this fact this Echo is normally used outside of characters burst windows.

targets.note: Lower end estimated in a Phrolova+Cantarella team, Higher end estimated in a Havoc Rover+Shorekeeper team.

weapons.name: Blazing Brilliance
weapons.note: Changli's signature weapon that's not only fantastic for her but also usable on all damage-focused Sword users who have a large portion of their damage originating from Resonance Skill damage. Offers a huge main stat of CRIT DMG% granting excellent scaling, 12% permanent ATK% and up to 56% increased Resonance Skill DMG% which should be at or close to full power during the bulk of your rotation when opening with one or two resonance skills.

weapons.name: Red Spring
weapons.note: Camellya's signature weapon is usable by all Basic Attack focused Sword wielding characters, but clearly designed with her in mind due to a lot of its power locked behind spending Concerto mid-rotation - something only Camellya can do. Offers a decent amount of ATK%, CRIT RATE% and Basic Attack DMG for all characters but a huge Basic Attack DMG bonus after spending Concerto.

weapons.name: Emerald of Genesis
weapons.note: Outstanding Sword choice, offering significantly higher base damage due to its 5★ rarity, as well as a stackable ATK% buff almost every character can effortlessly get 1 stack of (but with 2 also being easily achievable by most when played correctly). Additionally has a good amount of Energy Regen, which on most characters will allow one sub-stat of Energy Regen to be allocated elsewhere to increase damage even further. Best Sword choice across the board with only S5 4★ Swords having a chance to compete with it.

weapons.name: Commando of Conviction
weapons.note: Exceptional all-around generic Sword gaining its bonus close to unconditionally as most Resonators almost always aim to make use of their Intro skill and very few characters spend more than 15 seconds on field during their duration.

weapons.name: Endless Collapse
weapons.note: Often inferior to Commando of Conviction for DPS, this sword is still a great F2P 4* option for characters who need the energy boost. Realistically however, only consider this option over Commando of Conviction if you have energy problems on your character.

weapons.name: Somnoire Anchor
weapons.note: An amazing, completely free 4* option for characters who have extended field times, providing a rare CRIT Rate boost and loads of ATK. However, due to the nature of its buffs stacking up over time, this sword will deminish a lot in power if the wielder swaps out in less than 10 seconds.

weapons.name: Lunar Cutter
weapons.note: Powerful sword for Resonators spending minimal time on the field - the shorter the better. Best for Hybrid characters executing their rotation fast and infrequently, but less powerful on Main DPS characters that aim to spend extended time on field.

weapons.name: Lumingloss
weapons.note: Sword option for Heavy and Basic ATK users with an easy to trigger passive - with the only downside being its 10 second time limit. For characters that use their Skill multiple times per rotation, this downside is a non-issue but for Main DPS characters who take up a lot of field time and don't use their skill often this sword can lose value.

teams.name: Best Team
teams.note: Ideally use Cantarella in the 2nd slot, Outro buffing Phrolova.

teams.name: Best Team (Main DPS)
teams.note: It is recommended to use Cantarella with Verina in this team — Shorekeeper takes extended field time that may result in cooldown issues.

sets.name: Chromatic Foam
sets.note: Best generalist option in Fusion Burst mode, grants Denia with 20% total Fusion Burst DMG increase for a small personal damage gain and most importantly a total of 37% Fusion DMG Bonus (including Main Echo) to the incoming character via Outro. Best mix of personal damage and buffing generally.

echoes.name: Reminiscence: Denia
echoes.note: Summon Echo that gives 12% Fusion DMG Bonus to the incoming character via Outro, adding to the 25% from the base set for a total of 37% Fusion DMG buff on Outro.

sets.name: Reel of Spliced Memories
sets.note: Best option in Tune Strain mode, gives a 10% self-ATK buff on the 2-piece and also a 20 Tune Break Boost buff team-wide which comes in handy to maximize on DMG Taken effects from Tune Strain.

echoes.name: Voidwing Moth
echoes.note: Transform Echo that can safely be cast at the very end of Denia's rotation before Outro, giving an extra 12% ATK buff to the incoming character.

sets.name: Flaming Clawprint
sets.note: Best choice for Denia in the Aemeath + Lupa team, with Lupa on Moonlit Clouds, in order to give the highest possible buffs to Aemeath via Lupa's Outro while maximizing on party-wide buffing and Denia's personal DMG.

echoes.name: Lioness of Glory
echoes.note: Summon Echo that gives 12% Fusion and 12% Liberation DMG Bonus when equipped in the main slot, useful for maximizing further on Denia's personal damage.

stats.note: Liberation DMG can provide higher benefit in Tune Strain teams due to a higher reliance on Liberation DMG (absence of Fusion Burst DMG), but otherwise, ATK% is equal/slightly stronger.

weapons.name: Forged Dwarf Star
weapons.note: Denia's Signature and best weapon, giving her a strong mix of personal damage and team-wide ATK buffing. Has close alternatives in the Fusion Burst team but definitely a worthwhile pickup for Tune Strain overall.

weapons.name: Stringmaster
weapons.note: Yinlin's Signature is the usual generalist weapon of choice for any Rectifier damage dealer, and Denia can definitely rely on it for great results as well even if this weapon lacks team buffing capabilities like her Signature.

weapons.name: Lethean Elegy
weapons.note: Another very strong generalist Rectifier option with a particularly high Base ATK and reduced potential in Tune Strain teams due to not activating the DEF Ignore part of the passive until the very end of the rotation.

weapons.name: Luminous Hymn
weapons.note: Simple ATK and CRIT Rate stat-stick for Denia, who does not benefit from this weapon's Spectro Frazzle-related effects.

weapons.name: Whispers of Sirens
weapons.note: Simple ATK and CRIT DMG stat-stick for Denia, who barely benefits from this weapon's Basic and Havoc DMG-related effects.

weapons.name: Rime-Draped Sprouts
weapons.note: Simple ATK and CRIT DMG stat-stick for Denia, who doesn't benefit from this weapon's Basic DMG-related effects.

weapons.name: Cosmic Ripples
weapons.note: Best permanently available option for Denia. Grants some Energy Regen and massive ATK boosts, but the lack of a CRIT stat definitely makes for a big gap between this weapon and her Signature. Still better than any 4-star by virtue of a much higher Base ATK.

weapons.name: Augment
weapons.note: This Battle Pass exclusive grants Denia a solid ATK buff upon casting Ultimate, alongside a CRIT secondary stat albeit with very low Base ATK which makes it pale in comparison to the likes of her Signature (or any 5-star for that matter), but still a viable weapon overall.

weapons.name: Radiant Dawn
weapons.note: This Battle Pass exclusive grants Denia a small ATK% boost upon casting her Skill and some Basic DMG that she doesn't care for. Lower than most weapons due to low Base ATK, much like any 4-star.

weapons.name: Waltz in Masquerade
weapons.note: Best no-gacha option for Denia in Fusion Burst mode, granting her a huge ATK boost but no other stats, making it a weaker version of Cosmic Ripples. Practically useless in Tune Strain mode because Denia won't activate the passive then.

weapons.name: Fusion Accretion
weapons.note: Grants some extra flat Energy upon casting Skill, but has no noteworthy stats beyond that. Weak 4-star that only grants lower quantities of ATK overall, not recommended.

weapons.name: Jinzhou Keeper
weapons.note: Best no-gacha option for Denia in Tune Strain mode, accessible from the start, grants a decent amount of ATK to get started on the game but should be replaced ASAP.

teams.name: Fusion Burst Team
teams.note: With Lupa, run Denia on Flaming Clawprint and Lupa on Moonlit Clouds. Have Denia be the first character to rotate and Outro into Lupa who Outros into Aemeath for the strongest array of buffs overall.

teams.name: Tune Strain Team
teams.note: Teammate alternatives to Mornye are not listed as you will experience very significant team DPS drop-offs when trying to replace her, making it not recommended to use Denia in Tune Strain mode without Mornye.

sets.name: Molten Rift
sets.note: Offers a 10% unconditional Fusion DMG% boost and an additional 30% Fusion DMG% after using a Resonance Skill for a grand total of 40% additional Fusion damage. On Encore, if using her standard rotation, make sure to cast a Resonance Skill right before casting Ultimate (you can cancel it instantly to save time while still activating the effect!)

echoes.name: Nightmare: Inferno Rider
echoes.note: Offers an unconditional 12% Fusion DMG and 12% Resonance Skill DMG boost when placed in the Main Echo slot, making it a solid choice for Fusion focused resonators who emphasize Resonance Skill damage. While Resonance Skill damage isn't Encore's main damage type, it does provide a solid enough boost to warrant usage due to how easy it is to activate this Echo skill comparatively to the non-nightmare variant.

echoes.name: Inferno Rider
echoes.note: Gives a 12% Basic Attack DMG bonus and 12% Fusion DMG bonus after being transformed into and its last of 3 hits was dealt, for a duration of 15 seconds. This makes this Echo preferable for characters who prefer Basic DMG over Skill DMG, but this option is more difficult to incorporate in rotations than the Nightmare variant, often requiring Swap Cancelling to be smooth. Still Encore's best choice overall if you can manage it properly.

sets.name: Flaming Clawprint
sets.note: Increases Fusion DMG Bonus by 10% unconditionally and gives all party members 15% Fusion DMG Bonus when casting Ultimate on top of giving the equipper 20% Liberation DMG Bonus, all of these effects lasting 35s (which means they can be permanently applicable if maintained). Note that this effect does not stack if running the set multiple times in the same team. Not optimal on Encore in her best teams, but definitely worth using in a Dual DPS team with Changli or Brant to also increase their damage. Note that this set forces Encore into using her Ultimate-enhanced Forte Heavy Attack due to boosting Liberation damage significantly.

echoes.name: Lioness of Glory
echoes.note: Increases Liberation and Fusion damage by 12% when equipped in the Main Slot, a simple Summon Echo that deals damage and doesn't cost any time or have any condition on the cast. The best and only option that the Flaming Clawprint Echo set has.

Yinlin's signature Rectifier is famous for its wide-spread use among all Rectifier damage dealers, Encore included. Thanks to its super high amount of CRIT Rate and generic damage boost on top of an easily activated ATK% boost, it stands above all other Rectifiers as the overall best weapon in the game.

weapons.name: Rime-Draped Sprouts
weapons.note: Calculations assume an instantly-cancelled Skill after Intro before Ultimate. Zhezhi's Signature weapon doesn't compare in terms of wide-spread usage to Stringmaster but remains fantastic on Encore thanks to its great base stats and its ramp-up Basic DMG Bonus effect when casting multiple Skills (which Encore can do just fine, while not benefitting from the off-field effect).

weapons.name: Whispers of Sirens
weapons.note: Cantarella's Signature gives good base stats and a 40% Basic Attack DMG Bonus for most of Encore's rotation, but isn't as strong in comparison to the above options as they give a higher amount of stats (as the Havoc RES Shred effect of this weapon is not exploitable by Encore at all).

weapons.name: Lethean Elegy
weapons.note: Phrolova's Signature weapon has a high Base ATK and good CRIT Rate and ATK buffs on top of a Skill DMG Increase and DEF Ignore effect. While all of these effects are good, the values are on the lower end, and since the big Echo Skill DMG Amplify effect isn't fully taken advantage of by Encore, which makes this weapon rank lower than the above options.

weapons.name: Luminous Hymn
weapons.note: Simple ATK and CRIT Rate stat-stick for Encore who does not benefit from this weapon's Spectro Frazzle-focused effects.

weapons.name: Cosmic Ripples
weapons.note: Encore's strongest permanently available option, which grants her a massive ATK stat as well as a ramp-up Basic Attack DMG Bonus effect.

weapons.name: Radiant Dawn
weapons.note: Calculations assume an instantly-cancelled Skill after Intro before Ultimate. The newest Battle Pass-exclusive provides a CRIT DMG secondary stat as well as an ATK and Basic Attack DMG Bonus increase when casting Skill, easily maintained throughout all of Encore's rotation, making it a great 4-star choice overall.

weapons.name: Augment
weapons.note: Battle Pass-exclusive weapon that gives lots of ATK and CRIT Rate. A simple yet effective choice.

weapons.name: Fusion Accretion
weapons.note: Calculations assume an instantly-cancelled Skill after Intro before Ultimate. Great weapon choice to ease Energy Requirements thanks to its good ATK increasing effects paired with a flat Energy restoration when casting Skill.

weapons.name: Jinzhou Keeper
weapons.note: A permanently available choice obtained either at the start of the game via a selection box or via gacha. Overall Encore's best F2P option as it gives a good amount of ATK, which is further boosted when casting Intro skill. Pales in comparison to above options due to not doing much else.

echoes.name: Corrosaurus
echoes.note: Always use Echo Active Skill before executing Galbrena's Enhanced Skill to generate Afterflame. Summon Echo that provides a small amount of damage and 20% Echo as well as 12% Fusion DMG Bonus when equipped in the main slot, being both of Galbrena's main damage types.

When both effects are stacked, it even gives a small DEF Ignore boost to further increase this weapon's potential. Overall this is her best choice easily.

weapons.name: Phasic Homogenizer
weapons.note: An amazing generalist permanently available pistol that can universally improve the wearer's ATK, DMG Bonus and CRIT DMG. Can get close to a lot of character signatures and is overall a must-have for most accounts.

weapons.name: The Last Dance
weapons.note: Simple ATK and CRIT DMG stat-stick for Galbrena, who does not benefit from this weapon's Skill DMG-increasing effects.

weapons.name: Spectrum Blaster
weapons.note: Simple ATK and CRIT DMG stat-stick for Galbrena who does not benefit from this weapon's Tune Break and Basic DMG-focused effects.

weapons.name: Static Mist
weapons.note: The standard banner 5-star is a great choice for Galbrena, having a fully utilized passive in Mono Fusion teams to buff the next incoming character's damage (Lupa for example), while still being generally useful via its high Base ATK, CRIT Rate and Energy Regen stats in any team. This makes it not face significant drop-offs compared to her Signature weapon, which isn't necessary to clear endgame contents thanks to Static Mist, provided Galbrena has good teammates to back her up.

weapons.name: Woodland Aria
weapons.note: Simple stat-stick for Galbrena, who does not benefit from this weapon's Aero Erosion-focused effects.

weapons.name: Solar Flame
weapons.note: This Battle Pass exclusive provides a good CRIT Rate stat as well as a ramp-up ATK and Heavy ATK DMG increase when dealing Basic or Heavy Attack DMG, all fantastic stats for Galbrena. However, it isn't as strong as any 5-star choice due to its lower Base ATK than the choices above.

weapons.name: Relativistic Jet
weapons.note: Overall a great 4-star choice for Galbrena who needs a slight amount of Energy. This weapon's passive increases ATK and restores flat Energy when casting Skill, which makes it a solid choice for her as it makes her not require any Energy Regen substats, although it's not comparable to any 5-star.

weapons.name: Pistols#26
weapons.note: The best no-gacha option, this craftable 4-star provides extra ATK over time assuming you don't get hit. This weapon will perform worse than calculated if Galbrena gets hit by enemies often, however it should still outclass any other option than the ones listed above.

sets.name: Wishes of Quiet Snowfall
sets.note: This Glacio Chafe DPS and Support focused set provides Hiyuki with a huge 25% CRIT Rate boost on top of 20% total Glacio DMG Bonus. This set is the best choice bar none due to its very high stat gains for Hiyuki specifically.

echoes.name: Reminiscence: Threnodian - Voidborne Construct
echoes.note: Simple Summon Echo, can be used at any point in the rotation and grants 12% Glacio DMG Bonus as well as 12% Liberation DMG Bonus when equipped in the Main Slot. No-brainer Main Echo choice for Hiyuki.

weapons.name: Emerald of Genesis

weapons.name: Everbright Polestar

weapons.name: Feather Edge

weapons.name: Fables of Wisdom

sets.note: Iuno and Augusta's best set. The only set that should be ran on Main DPS Iuno. This totals to 30% ATK and 20% CRIT DMG, which is the best set for Iuno and Augusta in specific as they are the only characters in the game who are able to fully stack up this effect.

echoes.name: Lady of the Sea
echoes.note: Simple summon Echo that gives 12% Liberation and 12% Aero DMG Bonus when equipped in the main slot. No restrictions on the cast and free damage for Iuno, making it the best choice.

sets.name: Moonlit Clouds
sets.note: Only consider this set on a Sub DPS Iuno. Near-equal in team damage to Crown of Valor in the best SubDPS Iuno teams. Offers 10% unconditional Energy Regen which makes reaching Energy requirements easy. Most importantly however, upon using Outro, grants the next character switching in a 22.5% ATK boost boosting their damage by a good amount.

echoes.name: Impermanence Heron
echoes.note: The best and only real option Moonlit Clouds has, as it grants an extra 12% DMG Bonus on top of the 22.5% ATK boost to the next character that Moonlit Clouds would usually give. Additionally restores a lot of Energy to the caster when it deals damage. However, on Iuno, it is best to cast this Echo at the start of her rotation and cancelling it via a dash (after her Closing Refrain skill) or via her Ultimate (after Intro).
