weapons.name: Moongazer's Sigil
weapons.note: On all fronts, Iuno's Signature is her best weapon. Gives a massive 36% DEF Ignore on Resonance Liberation DMG stacked instantly after an Intro and easily maintained by Iuno's ability to apply several Shields to herself, all the while unconditionally giving 20% Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus and a massive CRIT Rate boost while retaining good Base ATK.

weapons.name: Verity's Handle
weapons.note: Has lower value for Main DPS Iuno due to a delayed Ultimate cast. Xiangli Yao's Signature Weapon is a perfectly acceptable alternative to Iuno — similarly to Jiyan's Signature on Augusta, it's an amazing second option thanks to the easily accessed 48% Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus that this weapon's effect provides on top of its high Base ATK and CRIT Rate stats.

weapons.name: Blazing Justice
weapons.note: The best generalist Gauntlets option, providing an easily maintained 8% DEF Ignore, high Base ATK and CRIT DMG as well as ATK%. Unfortunately for anyone but Zani, the Spectro Frazzle DMG Amplify effect on this weapon is wasted, making it rank lower for Iuno than the above options.

weapons.name: Tragicomedy
weapons.note: Simple ATK and CRIT Rate stat-stick for Iuno, who does not benefit from this weapon's Heavy Attack DMG-focused effect.

weapons.name: Pulsation Bracer
weapons.note: Strongest permanently available option for Iuno that acts as a simple ATK and CRIT Rate stat-stick.

weapons.name: Abyss Surges
weapons.note: This permanent banner 5-star provides some Basic and Skill DMG increases that are completely wasted on Iuno — but fret not as its massive Base ATK and ATK% stats make it rank above the majority of 4-star weapons.

weapons.name: Aether Strike
weapons.note: Has significantly lower value for Main DPS Iuno due to a delayed Ultimate cast. Significantly worse than Abyss Surges at R1. This Battle Pass exclusive offers a big boost to ATK and Resonance Liberation DMG when casting Ultimate, all the while having a nice CRIT DMG secondary stat, making it one of the best options for Iuno in spite of the low Base ATK.

weapons.name: Stonard
weapons.note: Significantly worse than Abyss Surges at R1. Calculations assume Closing Refrain is used. This Battle Pass exclusive provides CRIT Rate and a Resonance Liberation DMG increase. In spite of its low Base ATK (like all 4-stars), Stonard is a fantastic weapon to equip on Iuno, rivaling some of the lower-ranked 5-star choices.

weapons.name: Celestial Spiral
weapons.note: Calculations assume Closing Refrain is used. Provides some extra Energy and ATK when casting a Skill, negating any Energy requirements on Iuno. Overall one of the better 4-star options that doesn't require the Battle Pass, but ranks below every 5-star due to low base stats.

weapons.name: Hollow Mirage
weapons.note: Provides some extra ATK increase over Legend of Drunken Hero which is dependent on not getting hit to upkeep. Even in the best conditions for this weapon, it's only slightly higher than the craftable, making it not recommended if better options are available.

weapons.name: Legend of Drunken Hero
weapons.note: Significantly stronger in a Main DPS team featuring Ciaccona, ranking above all non-BP & 5-star options. Best 4-star choice that doesn't require a single pull to acquire — simply requires weekly boss materials to craft and increases ATK by a good amount, especially when attacking enemies with Negative Statuses inflicted on them for an even higher ATK boost. Falls behind any above options due to not giving good stats (just ATK%).

teams.note: Chisa is only best in slot with yangyang-xuanling - prioritize Shorekeeper with Augusta.

teams.name: Team #2: Main DPS Iuno
teams.note: Mornye is only best with Lynae on the team. Only use Aero Rover over Shorekeeper with Ciaccona as your second slot partner. Use Shorekeeper in other scenarios (using Ciaccona in the third slot with Lynae is also amazing).

sets.note: Offers 10% unconditional Energy Regen which makes reaching Energy requirements easier. Most importantly however, upon using Outro, grants the next character switching in a 22.5% ATK boost boosting their damage by a good amount.

echoes.note: Supportive Echo that can be run at the cost of a sizeable chunk of damage for the character who equips, trading personal gain for team benefits. Should always be used and immediately switch cancelled right before performing an Outro, leading to another DPS. When done so will grant the next character switching in 12% increased DMG% which when combined with the 5P Moonlit set which also grants 22.5% ATK% under the same conditions makes for a sizeable boost. While the echo does lower the damage of whoever wears it, it grants a massive chunk of energy on use usually saving 1 or sometimes even 2 Energy Regen sub stats that may otherwise be needed by the wearer allowing for some damage to be recovered.

weapons.name: Verity's Handle
weapons.note: Xiangli Yao's Signature weapon provides high Base ATK, CRIT Rate, DMG Bonus and an extra Liberation DMG Bonus effect when casting Ultimate. Since Jianxin's Ultimate is the majority of her damage, on top of its strong base stats, this weapon is her best in slot.

weapons.name: Moongazer's Sigil
weapons.note: Provides a significant amount of CRIT Rate and ATK and increases Liberation DMG by 20% throughout the whole rotation. Additionally allows Liberation DMG to ignore up to 36% enemy DEF after casting Intro (full stacks) or obtaining Shields (up to 5 stacks at 5 Shields applied). Jianxin can fulfill both of these conditions, but for the first out of her two alternating rotations, the Ultimate won't get the full DEF Ignore effect (only 10 ticks without the explosion). This makes the weapon rank lower than Xiangli Yao's, but she still uses it well.

weapons.name: Blazing Justice
weapons.note: The best generalist Gauntlets choice, providing high Base ATK and CRIT DMG while also giving a general 12% ATK and 8% DEF Ignore for 6s when casting Basic Attacks. Ensuring uptime on this effect for Jianxin's second rotation is rather difficult, but if properly done it can be as good as Moongazer's Sigil.

weapons.name: Tragicomedy
weapons.note: ATK and CRIT Rate stat-stick for Jianxin, who takes minimal advantage of this weapon's short-lasting Heavy Attack DMG-increasing effect.

weapons.name: Abyss Surges
weapons.note: Jianxin's best permanently available Gauntlets choice. Increases Energy Regen which alleviates her requirements and also provides a huge amount of ATK. The Basic and Skill DMG increases aren't unused but not particularly strong. Still a very strong choice for Jianxin overall.

weapons.name: Aether Strike
weapons.note: This Battle Pass exclusive provides a big chunk of CRIT DMG, as well as extra ATK and Liberation DMG Bonus when casting Ultimate, making it a strong overall option for Jianxin who desires all of these stats.

weapons.name: Celestial Spiral
weapons.note: Increases ATK by a good amount but also has a very niche Flat Energy restoration effect when casting Skill which helps alleviate Jianxin's Energy Regen requirements, which makes it a strong 4-star alternative.

weapons.name: Stonard
weapons.note: This Battle Pass exclusive gives a good amount CRIT Rate despite a rather low Base ATK and increases Liberation DMG when casting Skill. While this is Jianxin's main damage type, it doesn't represent much of her damage total and as a result this weapon falls behind in performance when compared to some other 4-stars.

weapons.name: Hollow Mirage
weapons.note: Niche 4-star weapon only worth using if nothing above is available. Gives extra ATK and DEF after using Ultimate which is only upkept consistently if the character does not take damage. This weapon's value gets worse if damage has to be taken by Jianxin (will happen often as she stands still when channeling her Forte!)

weapons.name: Legend of Drunken Hero
weapons.note: The best option that doesn't require any gacha and is permanently accessible. Simple ATK stat-stick for Jianxin who is unable to take advantage of this weapon's additional ATK boosts if Negative Statuses are applied on enemies, since none of her best teams make use of statuses currently.

weapons.name: Marcato
weapons.note: Much stronger in a team context if shortening Jianxin's rotations is significantly beneficial. Still ranks below most 4-stars in any case. Provides lots of Energy Regen making all Energy requirements a joke, and provides up to 16 Concerto Energy at R5 when casting Skill, aiding significantly in speeding up certain character rotations.

weapons.name: Originite: Type IV
weapons.note: If you're playing Jianxin in the Support role, here is the Weapon you should use on her (so she can trigger the Rejuvenating Glow set): Gauntlets with the unique function of adding healing to a characters kit causing their Basic Attacks to restore a small amount of health to themselves with a cooldown of 3 seconds. The Gauntlets have bad combat stats and the heal would otherwise be considered terrible for most content but it allows characters to activate the incredibly powerful 5P Rejuvenating Glow set which requires healing to buff. This weapon should only be equipped when aiming to use the set on a character who could not otherwise heal.

sets.name: Celestial Light
sets.note: Offers a 10% unconditional Spectro DMG% boost and an additional 30% Spectro DMG% after using the intro lasting 15 seconds for a grand total of 40% additional Spectro damage for most of your damage window.

echoes.name: Jué
echoes.note: Best main Echo for Jinhsi specifically, as it's a simple summon Echo that deals a good chunk of damage over time while giving a 16% Skill DMG Bonus on cast. This DMG Bonus can encompass both of the empowered Skills she does per rotation if her rotation is executed properly, all at no extra field time commitment thanks ot the Echo being a Summon.

weapons.name: Kumokiri
weapons.note: Very high CRIT Rate, solid Base ATK and up to 16% Liberation DMG Bonus make this weapon the second best weapon Jinhsi has after her Signature.

weapons.name: Wildfire Mark

She will not tend to extend this weapon's effect to gain Fusion DMG Bonus, however doing so can be considered in a team with Brant or Mortefi to get extra leverage out of this weapon's effects (which would not make it better than her Signature, but improve its performance a bit).

weapons.name: Verdant Summit
weapons.note: Simple ATK, DMG Bonus and CRIT DMG stat-stick for Jinhsi, who does not benefit from this weapon's Heavy DMG-related effects.

weapons.name: Radiance Cleaver
weapons.note: Best permanently available option for Jinhsi, which acts as a simple ATK and CRIT DMG stat-stick for her.

weapons.name: Thunderflare Dominion
weapons.note: While this weapon gives very high Base ATK, it does so at the cost of CRIT, and on Jinhsi its Heavy Attack-related effects are unusable making this weapon viable but not the best.

weapons.name: Lustrous Razor
weapons.note: This permanent weapon option gives lots of ATK and some Energy Regen which alleviates Jinhsi's Energy Regen requirements. Plus, she can maximize its passive effect to increase Liberation DMG. However, due to its lack of CRIT stats like the above options, it ranks worse overall.

weapons.name: Aureate Zenith
weapons.note: This Battle Pass exclusive is the best 4-star as it gives some CRIT alongside ATK, but its low base ATK much like all other 4-stars makes it rank worse than any 5-star options.

weapons.name: Waning Redshift
weapons.note: Provides ATK and flat Energy which helps alleviate Energy Regen requirements, one of the better 4-star choices available.

weapons.name: Helios Cleaver
weapons.note: Best fully F2P accessible-option, giving a solid amount of ATK but nothing else.

teams.name: Best Team
teams.note: Cantarella can be used instead of Zhezhi if there are temporary Endgame buffs favouring Echo Skill casts. Verina can be stronger than Shorekeeper if CRIT consistency isn't a problem. Otherwise, Shorekeeper is always the best choice.

teams.name: Quickswap Team
teams.note: Verina must be used with Brant and Changli in order to have Coordinated Attacks on the team. Generally difficult teams to pilot for casual players - not recommended unless you know what you're doing.

teams.name: Budget Team
teams.note: Mortefi is only strong if highly invested on Empyrean Anthem and a traditional Verina build, otherwise consider Yuanwu on Rejuvenating Glow with Verina on Moonlit Clouds.

sets.name: Windward Pilgrimage
sets.note: Best set for Aero Main DPS characters who can apply Aero Erosion or have an Aero Erosion applier on the team. Grants 10% Aero DMG Bonus and an extra 30% Aero DMG Bonus as well as 10% CRIT Rate for 10s when attacking targets inflicted with Aero Erosion. Offers an extra 10% CRIT Rate over the other Aero sets such as Gusts of Welkin or Sierra Gale, providing extra overall damage so long as Aero Erosion is present on the enemy. In teams without Aero Erosion appliers however, this set is useless comparatively to Sierra Gale.

echoes.name: Nightmare: Kelpie
echoes.note: This Echo provides a free decent amount of Aero DMG when casting Outro Skill in all situations, provides 12% Aero DMG Bonus to Jiyan and while its Transform Active Skill is not used in Jiyan's rotations, it is the best Main Echo he has, albeit by a very small difference when compared to Reminiscence: Fleurdelys (pick what has the best substats overall!)

sets.name: Sierra Gale
sets.note: Offers a 10% unconditional Aero DMG% boost and an additional 30% Aero DMG% after using the intro lasting 15 seconds for a grand total of 40% additional Aero damage for Jiyan's damage window.

echoes.name: Nightmare: Feilian Beringal
echoes.note: Offers an unconditional 12% Aero DMG and Heavy ATK boost when used as the Main Echo, and additionally is a Summon-type echo making it easy to use in any character's rotation, which often makes it the best option for any character using the set.

echoes.name: Feilian Beringal
echoes.note: Gives the same buffs as its Nightmare variant, but only after being transformed into, for a duration of 15 seconds. This Echo compensates by dealing close to double the damage of the Nightmare and giving more Energy to the character using it, but it's more difficult to incorporate into rotations, as it needs to be Swap Cancelled after the first hit to be used smoothly while making sure your character gets its buffs.

weapons.note: Augusta's Signature provides Jiyan with a massive Base ATK, a small CRIT Rate boost and some Heavy DMG. Not quite as good as his own Signature but still a very nice weapon to use on him.

weapons.name: Ages of Harvest

weapons.name: Kumokiri

weapons.name: Radiance Cleaver
weapons.note: Best permanently available option for Jiyan, which acts as a simple ATK and CRIT DMG stat-stick for him.

weapons.name: Aureate Zenith

weapons.name: Lustrous Razor
weapons.note: Weakest 5-star choice that doesn't grant CRIT from its stats but instead focuses on higher ATK and some Energy Regen. Still viable for Jiyan, but not favoured over above options.

weapons.name: Autumntrace
weapons.note: This Battle Pass exclusive grants Jiyan some scaling ATK and some CRIT Rate, which is acceptable but not recommended over 5-star choices due to its weak Base ATK.

weapons.name: Meditations on Mercy
weapons.note: Strongest no-gacha weapon for most Broadblade characters, granting a lot of ATK particularly if Negative Statuses are present on the enemy, but not recommended over 5-star choices.

teams.name: Lynae Team

sets.name: Endless Resonance
sets.note: Offers a 10% unconditional ATK% boost and an additional 5% ATK% for every 1.5 seconds the equipped character has been actively on-field - up to 20% after 6 seconds, totalling 30% additional ATK% after fully ramped. This set is completely incompatible with quickswap playstyles, but for the hypercarry playstyle Lingyang will generally use, this is his best set by a small margin.

echoes.name: Mech Abomination
echoes.note: Very easy echo to use that should be used at the very beginning of the burst window right after the Intro. Thanks to its instant cast there is no thinking required and you can enjoy your ATK% boost and some nice burst damage.

sets.name: Frosty Resolve
sets.note: This set grants permanent Resonance Skill DMG% and even bigger Glacio and Skill DMG increases when casting Skill and Liberation respectively. While the second Skill DMG boost is not upkept consistently by Lingyang, he does benefit from the stat and the Glacio DMG boost is additionally appreciated, making it his second best set and his best set that can be used in quickswap compositions.

echoes.name: Sentry Construct
echoes.note: The Sentry Construct is the most effective Main echo choice for Frosty Resolve users thanks to its passive 12% Glacio and Resonance Skill DMG% bonuses which are active at all times. The transformation ability of Sentry Construct is also powerful, swap cancellable, usable in the air and accessible more often than other Echoes, thanks to its ability to recharge cooldown when the user activates their Resonance Liberation.

sets.name: Freezing Frost
sets.note: Offers a 10% unconditional Glacio DMG% boost and up to an additional 30% Glacio DMG% after you land 3 Basic or Heavy Attacks for a grand total of 40% additional Glacio damage after fully ramped.

echoes.name: Lampylumen Myriad
echoes.note: Provides a total of 12% Glacio and Skill DMG boosts when casting all 3 hits for 15s, deals a good amount of damage and freezes enemies for a short duration on the final hit. All great things, but the problem with this Echo is that it takes a while to cast and is best used pre-rotation before Intro by swap cancelling out of the final hit. This takes a lot of time to execute and is the main reason why Freezing Frost does not rank above other Glacio damage-focused sets like Frosty Resolve.

sets.name: Eternal Radiance
sets.note: Offers a 10% unconditional Spectro DMG% boost, a 20% CRIT RATE buff for 15 seconds after inflicting Spectro Frazzle and further 15% Spectro DMG% boost for 15 seconds after attacking an enemy that has 10 Spectro Frazzle stacks. For characters that have the capability to inflict Spectro Frazzle in their kit the 20% CRIT RATE is all but permanant, while the 15% Spectro DMG boost should maintain decent uptime in Spectro Frazzle focused teams. Generally the best in slot set for all characters capable of inflicting Spectro Frazzle. When playing Phoebe in Absolution, she will require the assistance of her team in order to activate the 15% Spectro DMG boost tied to hitting enemies with at least 10 stacks of Spectro Frazzle - as in this state she cannot achieve that herself.

echoes.name: Nightmare: Mourning Aix
echoes.note: Gives 12% Spectro DMG Bonus when equipped in the Main Slot. Trades off character buffing for personal damage from the Echo Skill cast itself, since it deals higher damage to enemies inflicted with Spectro Frazzle. Overall a super negligible difference from Capitaneus though.

echoes.name: Capitaneus
echoes.note: Gives 12% Spectro and 12% Heavy DMG Bonus when equipped in the Main Slot. Trades off damage from the Echo Skill cast for character buffing which makes it slightly stronger in most teams except Lynae where Liberation damage takes more of Phoebe's damage total.

sets.name: Moonlit Clouds
sets.note: This set sacrifices Phoebe's personal damage in order to provide higher buffing to a single character, making it the best set for Hybrid Phoebe as a Zani buffer. It provides an extra 10% Energy Regen to the wielder unconditionally and gives 22.5% ATK to the incoming character for 15s after casting Outro skill.

echoes.name: Impermanence Heron
echoes.note: The best and only real option 5P Moonlit Clouds has, as it grants an extra 12% DMG Bonus on top of the ATK boost to the next character that Moonlit Clouds would usually give. Additionally restores a lot of Energy to the caster when it deals damage, though this won't really see use on Phoebe since it will be usually cancelled by her Outro.

stats.substats: Energy Regen (Until Satisfied) > CRIT Rate = CRIT DMG > ATK% > ATK > Heavy ATK DMG%

targets.note: Within the Lynae+Spectro Rover team, the requirement is approximately 111%, with this number going up when using her as a support for Zani.

weapons.name: Luminous Hymn
weapons.note: Phoebe's signature weapon gives her a ton of CRIT Rate, ATK%, Heavy and Basic DMG bonus under the condition that the enemy is affected by Spectro Frazzle - it even amplifies Spectro Frazzle DMG after an Outro. All of these perks make this weapon the best for Phoebe both as a DPS and a Support.

weapons.name: Lethean Elegy
weapons.note: Phrolova's Signature is really good on Phoebe because it provides much higher Base ATK than both Stringmaster and her own Signature as well as 8% DEF Ignore permanently simply after casting Echo Skill which she can do immediately. As a result, this weapon's high ATK scaling means she never overcaps on CRIT Rate (which she can do on other weapons) and it makes this weapon a fantastic choice for her.

weapons.name: Stringmaster
weapons.note: The classic best generalist Rectifier DPS weapon in the game provides a ton of CRIT Rate, DMG Bonus, and ATK when dealing Skill damage which Phoebe takes great advantage of, making for one of her best weapon choices by far.

weapons.name: Whispers of Sirens
weapons.note: Cantarella's Signature gives Phoebe a lot of CRIT DMG and Basic DMG Bonus when casting Echo Skill after Intro which she can do immediately, bringing some solid damage boosts to the table.

weapons.name: Rime-Draped Sprouts
weapons.note: Slightly worse version of Whispers of Sirens, providing less Basic DMG for the same base stats.

weapons.name: Augment
weapons.note: Best 4-star option for Phoebe, this Battle Pass exclusive provides lower Base ATK than 5-star options but it makes back for it with its CRIT secondary stat and an easily activated passive effect, making for a strong weapon choice.

weapons.name: Cosmic Ripples
weapons.note: Best permanently accessible option for Phoebe, providing Energy Regen and a scaling Basic DMG Bonus buff which are good stats for Phoebe, however it lacks a CRIT stat and makes Phoebe's ATK oversaturate which is less than ideal compared to the above options. Still, it works well enough to clear endgame contents with.

weapons.name: Ocean's Gift
weapons.note: If you happened to get this weapon during its original event in version 2.1, it's a solid choice for Phoebe as it gives her a lot of Spectro DMG Bonus when applying Spectro Frazzle. It additionally has higher-end Base ATK for 4-star weapons but provides a low secondary ATK% stat in exchange which makes it pale in comparison to the above options while still remainning viable.

weapons.name: Radiant Dawn
weapons.note: Simple ATK, CRIT DMG and Basic DMG Bonus stat-stick for Phoebe who can easily take full advantage of this weapon's passive during her rotation.

weapons.name: Waltz in Masquerade
weapons.note: Best no-gacha option available for Phoebe who can take full advantage of its passive in non-Zani teams using her and another teammate's Spectro Frazzle application to get good ATK buffs if nothing else is available.

teams.name: Alternative Team (Absolution)
teams.note: Ciaccona is the best and only partner for Absolution Phoebe in Whimpering Wastes, and in that mode in specific she is best used with Lynae, Shorekeeper or Chisa (in Quickswap only).

teams.name: Best Team (Confession)
teams.note: Spectro Rover is the strongest partner by far if played in Quickswap. The majority of players should however stick to Shorekeeper for the easiest experience.

teams.name: Expert Quickswap (Absolution)
teams.note: Only use this team if you have a lot of quickswap experience, else consider other teams. Ciaccona is only worth using for Whimpering Wastes.

teams.name: Triple Spectro Team (Absolution)
teams.note: Spectro Rover should be on Moonlit Clouds.

sets.name: Dream of the Lost
mix: Havoc Eclipse, Midnight Veil
Endless Resonance, Reel of Spliced Memories
Frosty Resolve
sets.note: Best Echo set for Phrolova as it permanently gives her 20% CRIT Rate and 35% Echo Skill DMG Bonus, providing big boosts to the majority of her rotation. Additionally, this is a 3-piece set, meaning it can be combined with a 2-piece set effect of your choice. Only used on Phrolova as its effects can only be activated when the equipped character has 0 Resonance Energy, something only Phrolova can upkeep permanently. This set is best combined with your choice of:

echoes.name: Nightmare: Hecate
echoes.note: A Transform Echo that is quick to cast but extends Phrolova's rotation by one second approximately, which is a worthy trade-off as it provides a 12% Havoc and 20% Echo Skill DMG Bonus when placed in the main slot.

stats.substats: CRIT RATE = CRIT DMG > ATK% > Skill DMG% > ATK

targets.note: Avoid any Energy Regen substats on Phrolova as her Ultimate does not cost any Energy.

weapons.name: Lethean Elegy
weapons.note: Phrolova's Signature is her best weapon by an alarming percentage, to a point where she's dependent on it to perform at the highest level due to the sheer amount of stats it provides — and her own damage being balanced around this fact. It gives her massive amounts of Base ATK, CRIT Rate, ATK%, Skill DMG Bonus, Echo Skill DMG Amplification AND DEF Ignore, all of which are fantastic stats that she works around, making this weapon her best option bar none.

weapons.name: Stringmaster
weapons.note: Stringmaster is a gift that keeps on giving for any Rectifier damage dealer. It's able to give Phrolova good base ATK but most importantly massive amounts of CRIT Rate, ATK% and DMG Bonus, with an even bigger ATK boost off-field which matches her playstyle. Unfortunately for Phrolova, she buffs her ATK by massive amounts already which dilutes this buff, but regardless of that fact Stringmaster remains her second best option simply by nature of massive amounts of stat buffs.

weapons.name: Whispers of Sirens
weapons.note: Phrolova is able to fully take advantage of this weapon's Havoc RES Shred effect when casting her Forte Heavy Attack, as it is also counted as an Echo Skill on top of her own Echo Skill cast. Unfortunately for Phrolova, this means it only buffs a small portion of her rotation as her Forte Heavy Attack is one of the last abilities she does before switching out, and she doesn't benefit that much from Basic Attack DMG. Nonetheless, as she is able to make partial use of its effects as well as get good stats from using it, it is a good option on her.

weapons.name: Rime-Draped Sprouts
weapons.note: Simple ATK and CRIT DMG stat stick for Phrolova who draws little benefit from this weapon's Basic ATK DMG-increasing effect.

weapons.name: Luminous Hymn
weapons.note: Simple ATK and CRIT Rate stat stick for Phrolova who draws little benefit from this weapon's Spectro Frazzle-related effects.

weapons.name: Cosmic Ripples
weapons.note: The best permanent weapon option available for Phrolova, which unfortunately doesn't provide much for her beyond ATK% and Basic ATK DMG Bonus, both of which she doesn't draw much benefit from, further widening the gap between standard and Signature.

weapons.name: Radiant Dawn
weapons.note: This Battle Pass exclusive grants Phrolova with a nice CRIT DMG boost as well as extra ATK and Basic DMG when casting Skill. While Phrolova barely makes use of the Basic DMG buff, the ATK buff from the passive is quite nice and overall makes this weapon the best 4-star choice for her.

weapons.name: Augment
weapons.note: This 4-star Battle Pass weapon gives good Base ATK to Phrolova while providing additional CRIT Rate. Additionally, its effect which increases ATK when casting Ultimate is good to buff Phrolova's off-field attacks, but unfortunately this buff will get diluted a lot by her 120% self-ATK buff when casting Ultimate which negates a lot of its benefits. It nonetheless remains a viable choice.

weapons.name: Fusion Accretion
weapons.note: One of the best 4-star weapons for Phrolova which simply gives Base ATK and ATK% with a further boost to ATK% when casting Resonance Skill, as its flat Energy boost is wasted on her. Falls behind the above weapon options due to a lack of good stats.

weapons.name: Jinzhou Keeper
weapons.note: Best fully F2P-accessible option, selectable for free at the start of the game or obtained through gacha. Gives a lot of ATK% via its stats and its passive activated upon Intro, but doesn't provide anything else, not making it stand out over the above options.

teams.name: Team #1: Best Team
teams.note: Lucilla is only best in the 2nd slot with Qiuyuan as the 3rd, and is not recommended with Shorekeeper. In general, unless with Qiuyuan she pivots to the 3rd slot with another character Outro buffing Phrolova.

teams.name: Team #2: Alternative Teams
teams.note: Only use Sigrika alongside Qiuyuan. Danjin + Roccia is also a possible pairing where Roccia moves to the third slot.

teams.name: Team #3: Dual DPS
teams.note: Suisui and Chisa are only best with Yangyang: Xuanling - else, prioritize Shorekeeper.

teams.name: Team #4: Phoebe Dual DPS
teams.note: Similar concept to Jiyan, with Spectro Rover acting as the Support. One of Phoebe's best teams assuming Phrolova has her Signature weapon.

sets.name: Heart of Evil's Purge
sets.note: Simple 20% CRIT DMG increase compared to the standard Aero DMG set Sierra Gale. Provides the same 40% total Aero DMG on the 5-piece alongside 20% CRIT DMG on the condition that Tune Strain can be applied - a condition Qingxiao instantly and easily fulfills.

echoes.name: Calamity Effigy
echoes.note: Provides 20% Aero DMG in total to the equipped character in the Main Slot. Transform Echo easily used at the end of Qingxiao's rotation and swap cancelled that provides the best stats Qingxiao can receive on her Signature Echo set.

stats.substats: Energy Regen (Until Satisfied) > CRIT Rate = CRIT DMG > ATK% > ATK > Heavy/Liberation/Basic DMG%

targets.note: Lower end was estimated in a team with Denia+Mornye/Lynae+Ciaccona, higher end was estimated in a team with Lynae+Mornye.

weapons.name: Glint of Clouds
weapons.note: Qingxiao's best weapon by a lot, her Signature grants her with a ton of CRIT Rate, lower-end base ATK but a ton of Aero DMG Bonus and some extra DEF Ignore to boot.

weapons.name: Red Spring
weapons.note: Camellya's Signature grants some Basic ATK DMG bonus that Qingxiao uses to an extent, but otherwise it's not an ideal replacement to her own Signature weapon. Decent alternative.

weapons.name: Azure Oath
weapons.note: Simple ATK, CRIT Rate and DMG Bonus stat-stick for Qingxiao, who does not benefit from this weapon's Havoc Bane-related effects.

weapons.name: Everbright Polestar
weapons.note: Simple ATK, CRIT Rate and DMG Bonus stat-stick for Qingxiao, who does not benefit from this weapon's Tune Rupture/Fusion Burst-related effects.

weapons.name: Emerald Sentence
weapons.note: Largely a simple ATK and CRIT Rate stat-stick for Qingxiao, buffs the party's Echo DMG Bonus by a bit but only makes an extremely small, particularly negligible difference in her teams.

weapons.name: Frostburn
weapons.note: Simple ATK and CRIT Rate stat-stick for Qingxiao, who does not benefit from this weapon's Glacio Chafe-related effects.

weapons.name: Emerald of Genesis
weapons.note: Best permanent weapon option, provides Qingxiao with good Base ATK and CRIT Rate to work with alongside one less Energy Regen roll needed thanks to its secondary stat and some extra ATK% from casting a Skill once. Not ideal compared to her Signature though.

weapons.name: Blazing Brilliance
weapons.note: Gives CRIT DMG instead of CRIT Rate as part of its main stats which is not favoured on Qingxiao, also gives Skill DMG which is essentially useless on Qingxiao. Not recommended over any other 5-star.

weapons.name: Feather Edge
weapons.note: Best 4-star weapon option, this Battle Pass exclusive provides CRIT Rate by default, and some ATK and Liberation DMG Bonus when casting Ultimate. Due to a much lower Base ATK than any 5-star weapon, it's not favoured over other options, but still is the best 4-star choice even if it's not recommended.

weapons.name: Lumingloss
weapons.note: This Battle Pass exclusive provides Qingxiao with a lot of ATK as well as Basic Attack and Heavy Attack DMG when Skill is cast. Falls behind due to a lack of CRIT stats when compared to above choices.

weapons.name: Commando of Conviction
weapons.note: Best permanently available, no-gacha option. Simple ATK stat-stick for Qingxiao. Not recommended in general, at best use temporarily before moving on to the much stronger Signature weapon.

teams.name: Best Team
teams.note: Any teammate alternatives are not recommended to use, as with Denia, not running Mornye suffers very significant team damage losses.

teams.name: Lynae Team
teams.note: Teammate alternatives don't suffer as significant drop-offs as with Denia, hence why they are suggested here separately.

sets.name: Law of Harmony
mix: Sierra Gale, Gusts of Welkin, Windward Pilgrimage, Sound of True Name
Moonlit Clouds
Endless Resonance, Reel of Spliced Memories
Empyrean Anthem, Tidebreaking Courage
sets.note: Optimally used in Phrolova teams and DPS Qiuyuan teams. Qiuyuan's best set to maximize his personal damage and buff Echo skill damage of teammates. Gives Qiuyuan 30% Heavy Attack DMG Bonus on the majority of his rotation and up to 16% Echo Skill DMG Bonus to the whole party, most often up permanently throughout a fight. A good mix of personal damage and team buffing makes for a strong set for him to use.

echoes.name: Reminiscence: Fenrico
echoes.note: The best generalist main Echo for this set for Qiuyuan as it grants 12% Aero and 12% Heavy DMG Bonus when equipped in the main slot, being Qiuyuan's 2 main damage types. Other than that, it's a simple Summon Echo that can deal damage on cast without any need to pay attention to the timing.

echoes.name: Bell-Borne Geochelone
echoes.note: Usable with 2P Moonlit Clouds and optimal in a Phrolova + Cantarella team provided Qiuyuan is at S0R1 investment or lower, this niche main Echo choice can be used to buff the whole party's DMG Bonus by 10% for 15s, including the majority of Qiuyuan's rotation. It is optimally used right before his Ultimate and after his Inkwash Basic 4.

sets.name: Moonlit Clouds
sets.note: Optimal with Galbrena + Shorekeeper. This set sacrifices Qiuyuan's personal damage in order to provide higher buffing to a single character. It provides an extra 10% Energy Regen to the wielder unconditionally and gives 22.5% ATK to the incoming character for 15s after casting Outro skill.

echoes.name: Impermanence Heron
echoes.note: The best and only real option 5P Moonlit Clouds has, as it grants an extra 12% DMG Bonus on top of the ATK boost to the next character that Moonlit Clouds would usually give. Additionally restores a lot of Energy to the caster when it deals damage. On Qiuyuan, this Echo may either be cast before his rotation starts (during your Shorekeeper's rotation for example) or it can be instantly interrupted via his Ultimate - this way, no Energy or damage is generated but the buff will still apply to the incoming ally.

stats.substats: Energy Regen (Until Satisfied) > CRIT Rate = CRIT DMG > ATK% > Heavy Attack DMG% > ATK

targets.note: The lower end was estimated by a team with Galbrena+Shorekeeper; the higher end was estimated by a team with Phrolova+Cantarella.

weapons.name: Emerald Sentence
weapons.note: Qiuyuan's Signature weapon is naturally his best choice, since it provides him with high ATK, CRIT Rate and Heavy Attack DMG stats, it perfectly suits his needs to maximize his damage. It additionally gives 20% Echo Skill DMG Bonus to all characters in the team which will be up permanently throughout a fight given a proper team rotation, slightly buffing the damage of Qiuyuan's best DPS characters to pair with. However, since Qiuyuan's personal damage is on the low end and the team buff on this weapon is rather low, it tends to be skippable since good permanently available options exist.

weapons.name: Red Spring
weapons.note: Simple ATK and CRIT Rate stat-stick for Qiuyuan, who does not benefit from this weapon's Basic Attack DMG-focused effects.

weapons.name: Blazing Brilliance
weapons.note: Simple ATK and CRIT DMG stat-stick for Qiuyuan, who barely benefits from this weapon's Skill DMG-focused effects.

weapons.name: Emerald of Genesis
weapons.note: Best permanently available option by far, since Qiuyuan wants Energy Regen, CRIT Rate and ATK and those are the stats this weapon provides, in high quantities as well. The 12% ATK increase when casting Skill is not exploited well by Qiuyuan, however all other effects of this weapon are very welcome on him and make for one of his top choices easily, able to replace his Signature weapon at a minimal loss.

weapons.name: Feather Edge
weapons.note: This Battle Pass exclusive has much lower Base ATK than all 5-star choices above which makes it much worse, however it does have a good CRIT DMG secondary stat and Qiuyuan can use the ATK% part of this weapon's passive well, which makes it the best 4-star choice.

weapons.name: Commando of Conviction
weapons.note: This weapon provides a lot of ATK throughout the whole rotation thanks to its universal passive activated upon Intro, making it a good 4-star choice for almost every Sword user including Qiuyuan.

weapons.name: Bloodpact's Pledge
weapons.note: A simple ATK and Energy Regen stat-stick for Qiuyuan, but since this weapon has 5-star level base stats it makes for his best free weapon choice despite not being able to use the passive effect at all (which means weapon rank does not matter).

teams.name: Best Team
teams.note: Phrolova can be stronger in multi-wave scenarios like Whimpering Wastes, but it's worth keeping in mind Phrolova also has stronger teams of her own.

sets.name: Moonlit Clouds
sets.note: This set sacrifices Rebecca's personal damage in order to provide higher buffing to a single character. It provides an extra 10% Energy Regen to the wielder unconditionally and gives 22.5% ATK to the incoming character for 15s after casting Outro skill.

echoes.name: Bell-Borne Geochelone
echoes.note: Provides 10% DMG Bonus for 15s as well as DMG reduction for 3 hits. If hit 3 times, the damage buff runs out, which means you want to avoid getting hit to make full use of this Echo; however, it's optimal on Rebecca without Quickswap as it can be cast right before her Ultimate (after her Forte Heavy Attack) in order to cancel the animation, buff your main DPS, the most of Rebecca's rotation, as well as the most of your Support's rotation (just frontload their damage).

echoes.name: Impermanence Heron
echoes.note: Theoretically a more consistent option in quickswap, that can increase the incoming character's DMG Bonus by 12% via Outro as well as restore extra Energy for the character if its damage lands on the enemy. However, this Echo is a transform that takes time to cast during Rebecca's rotation, meaning it must be cast before her rotation - restricting this Echo's use to quickswap teams.

sets.name: Shadow of Shattered Dreams
mix: Void Thunder
Endless Resonance, Reel of Spliced Memories
Moonlit Clouds, Empyrean Anthem, Tidebreaking Courage
sets.note: Grants Rebecca an easily activated Basic and Heavy DMG Bonus increase. This is a 1-piece set with only 1 Main Echo possible that also grants Rebecca additional CRIT Rate, making it the overall best blend of stats she can have for her personal damage (sacrificing team buffing in the process), paired alongside 2 2-piece sets. These sets include:

echoes.name: Reminiscence - Nightmare: Adam Smasher
echoes.note: Only Echo for the Shadow of Shattered Dreams set, simple summon Echo that grants an extra 15% CRIT Rate to Lucy or Rebecca.

sets.name: Pact of Neonlight Leap
sets.note: Lynae's Signature Echo set can be utilized by Rebecca (in Lucy's team specifically) which can grant a higher total set of buffs than what Moonlit Clouds provides. However, due to the inability of this Echo set to increase Rebecca and her Support's damage as well (possible with Bell-Borne Geochelone main Echo), it is a very close contender but not a stronger one than Moonlit Clouds, with lower overall usability in non-Lucy teams. It is still a close contender if you have the Echoes and don't want to farm a separate Moonlit set for Rebecca though.

echoes.name: Hyvatia
echoes.note: Simple summon Echo with the special property of giving an extra 10% DMG Bonus to the next character switched into via an Outro. Sacrifices small amounts of personal damage usually seen in Main Echoes for extra damage increase to the DPS, which is highly preferred by buff-focused characters.

stats.substats: Energy Regen (Until Satisfied) > CRIT Rate = CRIT DMG > Basic DMG% > ATK% > ATK

targets.note: Generally suitable for all Rebecca teams.

weapons.name: Skull Thrasher
weapons.note: Rebecca's Signature is of course her best in slot, as it can boost party-wide ATK more significantly than its permanent counterpart Static Mist, while giving Rebecca higher damaging stats with its Basic DMG and CRIT DMG bonuses.

weapons.name: Spectrum Blaster
weapons.note: Lynae's Signature provides Rebecca with a constant Basic DMG Bonus self-buff as well as significant ATK and CRIT Rate bonuses. While it doesn't offer the team-wide DMG Bonus buff as Rebecca can't apply Tune Rupture, it comes out on top of other options below it by sheer personal damage increase alone, making it a very strong alternative to her Signature.

weapons.name: Static Mist
weapons.note: Best permanent option when privileging Team DPS. While this weapon offers lower personal damage than a lot of others below it, the ATK% buff it offers to the next incoming character via Outro makes it a very strong weapon for any Pistols 2nd slot buffer, and Rebecca is no exception, as this weapon constitutes a perfect permanent option and alternative to her Signature.

weapons.name: Phasic Homogenizer
weapons.note: This weapon hones in on Rebecca's personal damage more than Static Mist, and it sacrifices team DPS to increase her own damage instead. Generally, this trade-off is not worth it in a full team context, but it's almost as good as Static Mist still and a good alternative to her Signature as well.

weapons.name: Woodland Aria
weapons.note: Simple ATK and CRIT Rate stat-stick for Rebecca, who does not benefit from this weapon's Aero Erosion-related effects.

weapons.name: The Last Dance
weapons.note: Simple ATK and CRIT DMG stat-stick for Rebecca, who barely benefits from this weapon's Skill DMG-related effects.

weapons.name: Spectral Trigger
weapons.note: Simple ATK and CRIT DMG stat-stick for Rebecca, who does not benefit from this weapon's Spectro and Heavy DMG-related effects.

weapons.name: Lux & Umbra
weapons.note: Simple ATK and CRIT DMG stat-stick for Rebecca, who does not benefit from this weapon's Heavy and Echo DMG-related effects.

weapons.name: Solar Flame
weapons.note: This Battle Pass exclusive is the best 4-star choice Rebecca has access to, it grants her with some ATK and CRIT Rate but falls behind any 5-star significantly due to a low Base ATK.

weapons.name: Relativistic Jet
weapons.note: Similar to Solar Flame, sacrifices some CRIT for some extra Energy upon casting Skill. Pales in comparison to 5-stars for the same Base ATK reason.

weapons.name: Pistols#26
weapons.note: Best no-gacha option if necessary, granting some extra ATK when no damage is taken by the character equipping it. Upgrade to 5-star options as soon as possible though.

teams.name: Edgerunners Team
teams.note: Shorekeeper may prove stronger in Whimpering Wastes as building Off-Tune multiple times on the same enemy (the reason why Mornye is ran) will almost never happen in that gamemode.

sets.name: Midnight Veil
sets.note: Offers a 10% unconditional Havoc DMG% boost alongside adding a large Havoc Damage hit to the Outro of the wearer. Also grants the incoming resonator a Havoc DMG% boost when the wearer uses their Outro. The set is better than Moonlit Clouds if and only if the equipped character's Echoes have endgame investment (with 9 or 10 CRIT substats total) and the character has a 5-star weapon equipped. If both conditions aren't met, Moonlit Clouds is a better choice.

echoes.name: Nightmare: Impermanence Heron
echoes.note: Offers an unconditional 12% Havoc DMG and 12% Heavy Attack DMG boost when placed in the Main Echo slot, making it a solid choice for Havoc focused resonators who emphasize Heavy Attack damage and are looking to use the 5P Midnight Veil set bonus.

sets.name: Moonlit Clouds
sets.note: Offers a 10% unconditional Energy Regen% boost taking some pressure off your gear when aiming at ER breakpoints. Also upon using Outro, grants the next character switching in a 22.5% ATK boost, amplifying any of your main damage dealers burst windows.

echoes.name: Impermanence Heron
echoes.note: Supportive Echo that can be run at the cost of a sizeable chunk of damage for the character who equips, trading personal gain for team benefits. Should always be used and immediately switch cancelled right before performing an Outro, leading to another DPS. When done so will grant the next character switching in 12% increased DMG% which when combined with the 5P Moonlit set which also grants 22.5% ATK% under the same conditions makes for a sizeable boost. While the echo does lower the damage of whoever wears it, it grants a massive chunk of energy on use usually saving 1 or sometimes even 2 Energy Regen sub stats that may otherwise be needed by the wearer allowing for some damage to be recovered.

stats.substats: Energy Regen (Until Satisfied) > CRIT Rate > CRIT DMG > ATK% > Heavy ATK DMG% > ATK
stats.note: Prioritize getting 70% CRIT Rate for the maximum possible buffs on her Ultimate once enough Energy Regen is accumulated.

targets.note: Lower end was estimated in a team with Phrolova+Cantarella, higher end was estimated in a team with Camellya+Shorekeeper.

weapons.name: Tragicomedy
weapons.note: Roccia's Signature gives her the best personal damage increases she can get thanks to a 48% Heavy DMG and 24.3% CRIT Rate bonus, making it her best in slot weapon.

weapons.name: Solsworn Ciphers
weapons.note: Sigrika's Signature gives high ATK and CRIT DMG base stats and also amplifies Echo Skill DMG which represents more of Roccia's total damage than you'd expect, making it a decent alternative to her Signature, although her CRIT Rate requirements will prove harder to hit.

weapons.name: Blazing Justice
weapons.note: Similarly to Solsworn Ciphers, ATK and CRIT DMG stat-stick with a little extra 8% DEF Ignore throughout Roccia's rotation to add to its value slightly.

weapons.name: Verity's Handle
weapons.note: ATK, CRIT Rate and DMG Bonus stat-stick for Roccia, who does not benefit from this weapon's Liberation DMG-related effects.

weapons.name: Pulsation Bracer
weapons.note: Best permanent banner option, grants Roccia some much-desired 24% CRIT Rate and a strong Base ATK to work with. Good stat-stick without any extra effects.

weapons.name: Moongazer's Sigil
weapons.note: Massive CRIT Rate stat-stick at the cost of lower Base ATK, Roccia does not benefit from this weapon's Liberation DMG-related effects though.

weapons.name: Abyss Surges
weapons.note: Second best permanent weapon option, grants Roccia some Energy Regen and a lot of ATK%, but CRIT Rate requirements will be difficult to hit and the DMG Bonus effects are practically useless on her.

weapons.name: Aether Strike
weapons.note: This Battle Pass exclusive grants Roccia some CRIT DMG and easily accessed ATK bonuses, making it the overall best 4-star choice theoretically. Still, meeting CRIT Rate requirements will prove difficult and this weapon is overall not recommended over Pulsation Bracer or her Signature, like any other 4-star, due to their lower Base ATK.

weapons.name: Celestial Spiral
weapons.note: Grants Roccia some flat Energy to alleviate Energy requirements and a decent Base ATK, but is just an ATK stat-stick beyond this with nothing much to provide Roccia with.

weapons.name: Stonard
weapons.note: This Battle Pass exclusive has a useless Liberation DMG-boosting passive for Roccia, but provides her with some CRIT Rate to alleviate her requirements there. Still not recommended though, due to low Base ATK and generally bad stats.

weapons.name: Hollow Mirage
weapons.note: Simple ATK stat-stick that relies on you not getting hit to leverage its ATK-boosting passive stacks fully. Not recommended on Roccia, like any other 4-star weapon.

weapons.name: Legend of Drunken Hero
weapons.note: Best no-gacha option for Roccia, simple ATK stat-stick with no passive to take advantage of whatsoever since it's Negative Status-related and Roccia plays in no such teams. sets.name: Rejuvenating Glow
sets.note: Offers a 10% unconditional Healing% boost and an most importantly a 15% ATK% boost for the entire team, lasting 30 seconds whenever you heal yourself or any of your allies. This bonus can be triggered by character abilities and weapon effects, is easy to keep active 100% of the time and is a big help for all party members.

echoes.name: Bell-Borne Geochelone
echoes.note: While usually a worse option for the Rejuvenating Glow set for damage than the Fallacy of No Return due to a shorter buff uptime, only granting 10% DMG Bonus for 15 seconds, the Bell-Borne Geochelone is the best choice for Cartethyia teams as Cartethyia can't benefit from ATK% but can benefit from the DMG% this Echo provides. It also has increased survivability by blocking 50% of the damage from a max of 3 hits which makes playing the team extremely comfortable.

sets.name: Windward Pilgrimage
sets.note: Used only with Cartethyia + Ciaccona at high investments due to the nature of Cartethyia's kit. Best set for Aero Main DPS characters who can apply Aero Erosion or have an Aero Erosion applier on the team. Grants 10% Aero DMG Bonus and an extra 30% Aero DMG Bonus as well as 10% CRIT Rate for 10s when attacking targets inflicted with Aero Erosion. Offers an extra 10% CRIT Rate over the other Aero sets such as Gusts of Welkin or Sierra Gale, providing extra overall damage so long as Aero Erosion is present on the enemy. echoes.name: Reminiscence: Fleurdelys

echoes.name: Dreamless

When using this Echo, always use it and immediately switch out so it deals it's damage and finishes its animation while the caster of the Echo is off the field. Due to this fact this Echo is normally used outside of characters burst windows.

weapons.name: Emerald of Genesis

Additionally has a good amount of Energy Regen, which on most characters will allow one sub-stat of Energy Regen to be allocated elsewhere to increase damage even further. Best Sword choice across the board with only S5 4★ Swords having a chance to compete with it.

weapons.name: Somnoire Anchor
weapons.note: An amazing, completely free 4* option for characters who have extended field times, providing a rare CRIT Rate boost and loads of ATK. However, due to the nature of its buffs stacking up over time, this sword will deminish a lot in power if the wielder swaps out in less than 10 seconds.

weapons.name: Commando of Conviction
weapons.note: Exceptional all-around generic Sword gaining its bonus close to unconditionally as most Resonators almost always aim to make use of their Intro skill and very few characters spend more than 15 seconds on field during their duration.

weapons.name: Lumingloss
weapons.note: Sword option for Heavy and Basic ATK users with an easy to trigger passive - with the only downside being its 10 second time limit. For characters that use their Skill multiple times per rotation, this downside is a non-issue but for Main DPS characters who take up a lot of field time and don't use their skill often this sword can lose value.

weapons.name: Endless Collapse
weapons.note: Often inferior to Commando of Conviction for DPS, this sword is still a great F2P 4* option for characters who need the energy boost. Realistically however, only consider this option over Commando of Conviction if you have energy problems on your character.

weapons.name: Lunar Cutter
weapons.note: Powerful sword for Resonators spending minimal time on the field - the shorter the better. Best for Hybrid characters executing their rotation fast and infrequently, but less powerful on Main DPS characters that aim to spend extended time on field.

echoes.name: Nightmare: Tempest Mephis
echoes.note: Offers an unconditional 12% Electro DMG and 12% Resonance Skill DMG boost when placed in the Main Echo slot, making it a solid choice for Electro focused resonators who emphasize Resonance Skill damage and are looking to use either the 5P Empyrean Anthem Echo or 5P Void Thunder set bonus.

weapons.name: Verity's Handle
weapons.note: Xiangli Yao's signature and an ideal weapon for any Resonance Liberation based Gauntlet user. Grants a tremendous 24.3% CRIT RATE boost and 12% generic DMG% boost all permanently and on top of that also grants an incredibly convenient 48% Resonance Liberation DMG% lasting 8 seconds on use of the wearers Liberation. Due to the timing of when this buff activates, it is almost always up when you need it most and the duration can also be extended up to 3 times for 5 seconds each time whenever you use a resonance skill. This extends the total duration of this buff to a whopping 23 seconds.

weapons.name: Amity Accord
weapons.note: Outstanding damage focused option for DEF-scaling damage dealers that deal a reasonable portion of their damage with their Resonance Liberation. Current best option for all DEF scalers.

weapons.name: Stonard
weapons.note: Specialist Gauntlets for Resonance Liberation scaling users, thanks to its passive that grants increased Resonance Liberation DMG% after using a Resonance Skill. Still usable by characters who don't focus specifically on Liberation damage as a big part of their kit, thanks to the reasonably high base stats but more importantly CRIT RATE main stat.

weapons.name: Guardian Gauntlets
weapons.note: Free to play accessible alternative for DEF-scaling damage dealers that make use of their Resonance Liberation as a damage dealing tool. A good alternative if you don't have Amity Accord.

weapons.name: Originite: Type IV
weapons.note: Gauntlets with the unique function of adding healing to a characters kit causing their Basic Attacks to restore a small amount of health to themselves with a cooldown of 3 seconds. The Gauntlets have bad combat stats and the heal would otherwise be considered terrible for most content but it allows characters to activate the incredibly powerful 5P Rejuvenating Glow set which requires healing to buff. This weapon should only be equipped when aiming to use the set on a character who could not otherwise heal.

weapons.name: Gauntlets of Voyager
weapons.note: An easily accessible supportive option with a reasonable amount of Energy Regen. It also grants the unique ability to gain a sizable chunk of raw Resonance Energy once every 20 seconds. For most character's rotations in teams, this bonus will be ready every time it's their turn to switch-in, making this weapon a great choice for any character who doesn't need damage but needs their Ultimate fast and has trouble accessing it otherwise. The flat energy gain is more powerful the less energy the character and team they are a part of can generate.

weapons.name: Abyss Surges
weapons.note: One of the top Gauntlets options in game with the only competitors being 4★ Weapons with multiple dupes. Offers high base ATK, ATK%, a good amount of Energy Regen to save at least 1 sub-stat on gear to be reallocated to better uses and a conditional bonus boosting Resonance Skill damage and Basic Attacks that is very easy to satisfy.

weapons.name: Originite: Type IV
weapons.note: If you're playing Yuanwu in the Support role, here is the Weapon you should use on him (so he can trigger the Rejuvenating Glow set): Gauntlets with the unique function of adding healing to a characters kit causing their Basic Attacks to restore a small amount of health to themselves with a cooldown of 3 seconds. The Gauntlets have bad combat stats and the heal would otherwise be considered terrible for most content but it allows characters to activate the incredibly powerful 5P Rejuvenating Glow set which requires healing to buff. This weapon should only be equipped when aiming to use the set on a character who could not otherwise heal.

teams.name: Best Team
teams.note: Make sure to run Yuanwu on Rejuvenating Glow and your third party member on Moonlit Clouds for optimal DPS!

sets.name: Eternal Radiance
sets.note: Offers a 10% unconditional Spectro DMG% boost, a 20% CRIT RATE buff for 15 seconds after inflicting Spectro Frazzle and further 15% Spectro DMG% boost for 15 seconds after attacking an enemy that has 10 Spectro Frazzle Stacks. For characters that have the capability to inflict Spectro Frazzle in their kit the 20% CRIT RATE boost is close to permanent, while the 15% Spectro DMG boost should maintain decent uptime in Spectro Frazzle focused teams. Generally the best in slot set for all DPS characters capable of inflicting Spectro Frazzle.

echoes.name: Capitaneus
echoes.note: Offers an unconditional 12% Spectro DMG and 12% Heavy Attack DMG boost when active in a resonator's Main Echo Slot, making it a solid choice for Spectro focused resonators who emphasize Heavy Attack damage and are looking to use the 5P Eternal Radiance set bonus.

echoes.name: Nightmare: Mourning Aix
echoes.note: Offers an unconditional 12% Spectro DMG boost when active in a resonators Main Echo Slot and gains a 100% DMG bonus to its attack against enemies inflicted by Spectro Frazzle. This echo is the go-to choice for most resonators capable of inflicting Spectro Frazzle, who are focusing on damage and are looking to use the 5P Eternal Radiance set bonus.

weapons.name: Blazing Justice
weapons.note: Zani's Signature weapon is by far her best option, thanks to its massive boosts in her best stats: 48.6% CRIT DMG with high ATK, 50% Spectro Frazzle Amplification, and even 8% DEF Ignore with a simple condition (that can be permanently triggered during any part of Zani's rotation). How much stronger this weapon is compared to other options depends on how many other sources of Frazzle Amplify you have access to. For example, with Phoebe's 100% Frazzle Amplify applied, the value of this weapon is diminished due to dilution, but without it, it becomes far more important.

weapons.name: Tragicomedy
weapons.note: Roccia's weapon is an amazing choice on Zani as all her attacks during her Ultimate stance are the Heavy Attack type while still being treated as Basic Attack casts for the purpose of this weapon's passive, giving her 48% Heavy DMG Bonus combined with an extra 24.3% CRIT Rate and high ATK make it the second best choice.

weapons.name: Verity's Handle
weapons.note: Beyond the usual high Base ATK, CRIT Rate and all-type DMG bonus buffs Xiangli Yao's weapon provides, Zani makes little use of the extra Liberation DMG Bonus effect so this weapon is comparably weaker than other options, but can still be considered as a good alternative due to raw stats alone.

weapons.name: Pulsation Bracer
weapons.note: The best permanently available option for Zani which acts as a nice ATK and CRIT Rate stat-stick for her.

weapons.name: Moongazer's Sigil
weapons.note: Simple ATK, CRIT Rate and Liberation DMG stat-stick for Zani who does not benefit from this weapon's DEF Ignore-related effects. Suffers from a low Base ATK and too much CRIT Rate causing Zani to easily overcap.

weapons.name: Abyss Surges
weapons.note: The extra Energy Regen and huge ATK boosts this weapon provides are very useful to Zani, but she has little use for the rest of its passive boosting Basic and Skill DMG. With that said, it remains the best permanently available choice thanks to its really high Base ATK and small Energy Regen boost.

weapons.name: Aether Strike
weapons.note: This Battle Pass exclusive is focused on buffing Liberation DMG which Zani barely benefits from, but luckily for her the CRIT DMG and ATK stats provided by this weapon are used well on her which makes it the best 4-star choice for her.

weapons.name: Celestial Spiral
weapons.note: One of the best 4-star weapons on Zani thanks to its solid Base ATK, ATK-increasing effects, and ability to restore flat Energy when Resonance Skill is cast, which eases Zani's build requirements requiring no Energy Regen at all.

weapons.name: Stonard
weapons.note: Similarly to Aether Strike, this Battle Pass exclusive is focused on buffing Liberation DMG which Zani barely benefits from, but Zani does benefit from the CRIT Rate stat this weapon has. Not better than the above 4-stars because it only buffs Liberation DMG and not ATK which Zani would prefer.

weapons.name: Hollow Mirage
weapons.note: Provides some extra ATK increase over Legend of Drunken Hero which is dependent on not getting hit to upkeep. Even in the best conditions for this weapon, it's only slightly higher than the craftable, making it not recommended if better options are available.

weapons.name: Legend of Drunken Hero
weapons.note: While this Rinascita craftable looks like it'd work well on Zani as she is a Negative Status character, unfortunately for her Heliacal Ember (which she converts Spectro Frazzle into) does not count as a Negative Status, which makes its passive only benefit Zani if Ciaccona or Chisa are on the team to apply other Negative Statuses than Spectro Frazzle. Seeing as neither are top teammate choices for her, this weapon is only used as a last resort F2P option.

sets.name: Empyrean Anthem
sets.note: Offers an unconditional 10% Energy Regen% and 80% Coordinated DMG boost. Also grants a passive supportive effect which triggers when the wearer of this set critically strikes with a Coordinated attack - this effect grants the on field Resonator an ATK% boost regardless if they're the wearer of the set or not. The set is better than Moonlit Clouds if and only if the equipped character's Echoes have endgame investment (with 9 or 10 CRIT substats total) and the character has a 5-star weapon equipped. If both conditions aren't met, Moonlit Clouds is a better choice.

echoes.name: Nightmare: Lampylumen Myriad
echoes.note: The best Echo for Zhezhi when running the Empyrean Anthem set as it grants her an extra Glacio and Coordinated Attack DMG boost when equipped in the main slot, without taking up rotation time as it is a simple Summon Echo.

sets.name: Moonlit Clouds
sets.note: Offers a 10% unconditional Energy Regen% boost taking some pressure off your gear when aiming at ER breakpoints. Also upon using Outro, grants the next character switching in a 22.5% ATK boost, amplifying any of your main damage dealers burst windows.

echoes.name: Impermanence Heron
echoes.note: Supportive Echo that can be run at the cost of a sizeable chunk of damage for the character who equips, trading personal gain for team benefits. Should always be used and immediately switch cancelled right before performing an Outro, leading to another DPS. When done so will grant the next character switching in 12% increased DMG% which when combined with the 5P Moonlit set which also grants 22.5% ATK% under the same conditions makes for a sizeable boost. While the echo does lower the damage of whoever wears it, it grants a massive chunk of energy on use usually saving 1 or sometimes even 2 Energy Regen sub stats that may otherwise be needed by the wearer allowing for some damage to be recovered.

targets.note: Lower Estimate is using Moonlit Clouds, highest estimate is using Empyrean Anthem, both in the context of a Carlotta+Shorekeeper team.

weapons.name: Rime-Draped Sprouts
weapons.note: Zhezhi's Signature and best weapon gives her significant ATK and CRIT DMG stat boosts as well as a scaling Basic DMG Bonus buff that particularly affects her off-field Coordinated Attacks, perfectly synergizing with her kit and giving her the highest damage output she can get.

weapons.name: Whispers of Sirens
weapons.note: Cantarella's Signature also gives Zhezhi a very high Basic DMG Bonus buff and the same base stats as her Signature, making it a near-equal alternative to her Signature weapon.

weapons.name: Lethean Elegy
weapons.note: Phrolova's Signature stands out as the only Rectifier with high Base ATK which works well on Zhezhi, not to mention the easily triggered Echo and Skill DMG Amplification as well as the DEF Ignore for 12s, all of which gives her a nice damage boost overall.

weapons.name: Stringmaster
weapons.note: Yinlin's Signature Rectifier is easily one of the best generalist options in the game, giving Zhezhi a nice but short-lived ATK% buff that can apply to some Coordinated Attacks and the most damaging part of her on-field rotation. However, buffs run out quickly which make it not as ideal as her Signature while still being a completely excellent replacement.

weapons.name: Forged Dwarf Star
weapons.note: Calculation also applicable to Luminous Hymn. Simple ATK and CRIT Rate stat-stick for Zhezhi, who does not benefit from this weapon's Fusion Burst and Tune Strain-oriented effects.

weapons.name: Cosmic Ripples
weapons.note: Best permanently available option for all Rectifier damage dealers, granting a scaling Basic DMG Bonus buff, some Energy Regen and a massive amount of ATK. Not as ideal as above options due to the absence of CRIT in the stats this weapon grants, but still a capable alternative.

weapons.name: Augment
weapons.note: Best 4-star weapon option, this Battle Pass Exclusive gets an easy-to-activate ATK buff when casting Ultimate and also gives a nice CRIT secondary stat but has lower Base ATK as a 4-star making it worse than any 5-star option.

weapons.name: Radiant Dawn
weapons.note: Another good Battle Pass Exclusive that grants ATK and Basic DMG when casting Skill, not as ideal as any 5-star due to low Base ATK but also gives CRIT DMG on its secondary stat, making it a decent choice overall albeit easily replaced.

weapons.name: Fusion Accretion
weapons.note: Grants some flat Energy when casting Skill and otherwise only gives some decent ATK increases. Replace this weapon when possible, but decent placeholder until 5-star options are acquired.

weapons.name: Jinzhou Keeper
weapons.note: Similarly to Fusion Accretion, best no-gacha option accessible at the start of the game but gives nothing except ATK and should be replaced as soon as possible.

teams.name: Best Team
teams.note: Verina can be equal to Shorekeeper in Jinhsi teams with enough crit-fishing (particularly with S2 Verina). Other options under specific circumstances may include Hiyuki+Chisa, or Mornye as a general Support at S1 and above (or R4 Discord and above as a Verina alternative).
